A 20-second vertical 9:16 video, shot as real handheld footage of a practical-effects fantasy scene. Real people, a real spear, a real grey misty bog. The camera stands on the far bank, with two dark elves just behind it, unseen at first. The woman from the references walks barefoot through the bog toward the camera, pulls an ice spear out of the mud, frost races up her arm and ice grows over her body, she roars and hurls the spear at a dark elf woman. In a close shot the spear streaks at the elf woman's chest, but a hand from the side snatches it out of the air inches from her: a dark elf man saved her. Furious, he glares across the bog. The elf woman draws an arrow and shoots the hero. In a wide shot the arrow flies at her, she sweeps her arms apart and a wall of ice erupts in front of the arrow. The video ends on the hero's face with a confident smile.

REFERENCES (four images). Each image may be a collage of a full-body figure and an inset face close-up. Use all parts as information about ONE character, but show ONE person only, never the collage layout, inset panel or the foggy forest background.
- Image 1 = HERO before the transformation. Full-body part: body, dress, jewellery, barefoot. Close-up part: the exact standard for her face, skin, freckles and hair in every shot where she is visible.
- Image 2 = hero AFTER the transformation: the ice armour (details below), rendered as real ice and frost, not neon. IGNORE the spear and background in it.
- Image 3 = DARK ELF WOMAN only: long wet black hair with a centre parting, pointed ears, amber-yellow eyes, freckled skin with dark red streaks on forehead and cheek, black-and-silver scale armour with layered shoulder plates, leather straps, bracers, long black skirt with a high slit, black thigh-high stockings, tall laced boots, quiver on her back, recurve bow in her left hand.
- Image 4 = DARK ELF MAN only: short black hair and beard, pointed ears, dark brown eyes, dark skin, black plate-and-leather armour with layered shoulder plates, black tabard with a pale silver bare-tree emblem, gauntlets, tall black boots, long sword on his hip. IGNORE the spear he holds in the reference: he has no spear of his own, hands free until the catch.

CHARACTERS: Exactly three people. The hero is in every shot until 00:09. The two elves stand on the far bank directly behind the camera and are NOT visible, not even as silhouettes, before 00:09. No other people, creatures, animals, figures in the fog or banners.

REALISM AND PRESERVATION (MOST IMPORTANT): It must look like a real camera recording of real people, not a render, not CGI, not a game cinematic. Same realism as the face close-up in image 1 for all three: visible pores, freckles, uneven natural skin tone, fine facial hair, flyaway and wet hair, real sweat and mud, no makeup look, no retouching, no plastic skin, no doll faces. Real fabric, leather, metal, mud, water, real ice with cloudy frost, bubbles and wet drips. The hero's warm natural tan, freckles, face, slim toned build, long straight silver hair and pale blue-grey eyes never change. The transformation only ADDS ice on top of her, never pale plastic or blue skin. The elves match their references in every shot.

HERO BEFORE: brown taupe linen wrap dress with a V-neckline, high side slit and long flowing skirt, thin gold belt with an oval buckle, two thin gold upper-arm bands, thin gold necklace with a small cross. Barefoot.

HERO AFTER (as image 2, real material): same face, freckles and silver hair as separate real strands, slightly frosted at the tips, never fluffy. Eyes stay pale blue with a faint cold reflection, not glowing lamps. Uneven plates of thick ice with cloudy white frost, clear translucent patches, ragged edges, wet in places, the blue only a faint reflection deep under the ice. Overlapping spiked ice shoulder plates, two fans of long jagged translucent ice spikes up to 1 metre tall behind the shoulders, ice forearm guards, ice gauntlets with pointed fingers, ice chest plate fully covering the chest up to a high lace-like ice collar, the original dress as a frost-stiffened skirt (never fur) with icicle fringes and the same slit, gold belt and gold arm bands set into the ice, flat-soled ice-plated boots growing up from her bare feet, no heels. No glossy plastic, no metal, no neon glow.

THE SPEAR: about 2.2 m, two ends. The FRONT is the ICE HEAD: a large irregular shard of clear glassy ice shaped like a spearhead, about 50 cm long, fractured jagged facets, internal cracks, pointed tip, and inside it a round blue "eye" with bright blue iris, radiating fibres and a vertical slit pupil, like a reptile's eye, with a soft cold glow. The BACK is a blunt dark wooden BUTT. The shaft is a dark, rough, knotty wooden pole with bark texture, wrapped in a thin transparent ribbon of ice in loose spirals, lower part splattered with wet mud; it stays dark wood the whole video.

SPEAR ORIENTATION (CRITICAL): At the start the spear is stuck HEAD DOWN, like a thrown javelin, at a slant of about 40 degrees from vertical: the ice head is at the BOTTOM with its pointed tip driven about 20 cm into the mud, its eye just above the mud surface, a ring of broken mud and a few bubbles around it. The long wooden shaft rises diagonally UP from it, ending in the blunt butt about 1.5 m above the ground. She grips the shaft about 1 m above the mud and pulls it UP and back, so the ice head comes OUT of the mud at the bottom, streaming mud; the spear is never flipped. Then she holds it by the shaft, ICE HEAD UP. For the throw she turns it so the ICE HEAD POINTS FORWARD at the target and the blunt butt is behind her hand; it flies head first and arrives head first. The ice head is never behind her hand.

LOCATION: grey misty bog in a cold spruce forest, about 25 m wide: dark wet mud, black puddles, wet moss, dead grass; thin dark spruce trunks fading into thick fog, pale grey sky, slow fog, fine cold drizzle, a few snowflakes. Mud is soft but holds her. The camera side is a low mossy slope.

THE ICE: as she transforms, the bog water around her freezes: thin cloudy ice sheets spread over the puddles and mud, crackle with irregular branching cracks, tilt and splinter. Cracks are uneven, never symmetrical, never a star pattern. The ground holds her.

CAMERA AND LOOK: vertical 9:16, real handheld camera, visible shake, slightly delayed autofocus, small focus misses, drizzle and fog drifting past the lens, faint grain, muted natural colours, flat overcast grey light, no hard shadows. No glossy beauty lighting, rim light, heavy grading, lens flare or smooth gimbal. The camera and operator are never visible. Axis: until 00:16 the camera stays in front of the hero, so she faces the camera side.

STORY:

00:00-00:02.5 HOOK
First frame already in motion. Vertical medium shot from the front, knees up: the hero in her brown dress walks barefoot and fast through shallow bog water straight toward the camera, the ice spear stuck head down and slanted in the mud beside her path, the ice head with the glowing blue eye at the bottom, the dark wooden shaft rising up into the fog. Mud splashes at her feet, hair and hem move in the wind. Her eyes are on the spear, never on the camera. At the end of the shot her hand rises to the shaft.

00:02.5-00:04 GRIP
Vertical close shot of the shaft. Her hand closes around the wood in ONE firm grip and she pulls the spear UP out of the mud with effort, the mud releasing the ice head at the bottom with a wet sucking sound, mud streaming off the glassy shard. As it comes free, frost forms on her skin: a thin film of ice races up her wrist and forearm and thickens into uneven plates, the gold arm band stays. Puddles around her feet begin to freeze.

00:04-00:06 TRANSFORMATION
Vertical full-body shot from the front at a low angle, three-quarter view, her whole figure inside the frame, fog behind. In two seconds ice and frost spread from her arm over shoulders, neck, chest, skirt and legs: plates form, the ice collar closes, the fans of ice spikes rise behind her shoulders, ice boots grow up from her bare feet, her silver hair frosts and whips in the wind. Ice sheets crack and tilt around her feet. She stands fully transformed, the spear upright in her right hand, ice head up.

00:06-00:07.5 ROAR
Vertical close shot of her face, neck and shoulders, slightly low angle. It starts on her face exactly as in the close-up of image 1, calm and intense, then a real human roar under strain: jaw open, brows down, neck tendons showing, still clearly the same woman with the same skin and freckles. Breath mist bursts into the fog, frost crystals on cheek, brows and hair, a faint cold blue light in her eyes.

00:07.5-00:09 THROW
Vertical wide shot from the front at a low angle, her full body in frame, bog and fog behind. Her eyes are locked on a target at the camera side, a dark elf woman she can see but the camera cannot. She turns the spear in her hand so the ICE HEAD POINTS FORWARD at the camera side, steps forward on the cracking ice, draws it back over her right shoulder with the blunt butt behind her hand, and hurls it straight at the elf woman with her whole body: back leg drives, torso rotates, arm whips through, hair and ice spikes swing. The spear leaves her hand flat and fast, ICE HEAD FIRST, a few frost crystals in its wake.

00:09-00:10.5 SPEAR AT HER CHEST
Cut to a vertical close shot of the dark elf woman (image 3) from shoulders to waist, in three-quarter profile facing the hero side at the left of the frame, fog behind her, bow in her left hand. The spear streaks in from the left edge at chest height, ICE HEAD FIRST, blurred and fast, aimed at the centre of HER chest, growing in the frame. She does not flinch. One continuous shot until the catch.

00:10.5-00:11.5 CATCH
Same close shot. When the ice head is about 15 cm from her chest, a gauntleted hand sweeps in from the right edge across in front of her and clamps the wooden shaft about 40 cm behind the head with a sharp crack. The spear stops dead, the ice head still pointing at HER chest, shuddering. Nobody is hit, no blood.

00:11.5-00:12.5 REVEAL
Vertical wide shot from the same side angle as the close shot, pulled back, both elves boots to head on the mossy slope in the fog, the hero side at the left of the frame. The spear lies horizontal in the air, ice head at her chest, butt toward the left. The dark elf man (image 4) stands beside her and slightly behind, on the right, outside the line of the spear, his arm reaching forward past her front, gauntlet clamped on the shaft, the ice head still pointing at her chest from 15 cm. It is clear that SHE was the target and he saved her.

00:12.5-00:14.5 ANGER
Vertical medium close shot of the elf man alone, chest up. He pulls the spear back and holds it upright beside his face, ice head up, the blue eye glowing next to his cheek, a thin rime of frost creeping over his gauntlet. His glare turns into rage: eyes narrowed and locked across the bog on the thrower, jaw clenched, lip curling, nostrils flaring, neck tendons tight, knuckles whitening on the shaft, a slow hard breath of mist.

00:14.5-00:16 THE ARROW
Vertical medium shot of the elf woman (image 3) from the front and slightly to the side, shoulders up, fog behind. In one smooth motion she pulls an arrow from the quiver over her shoulder, nocks it, draws the string back to her cheek, her amber eyes narrowed along the arrow at the hero across the bog, then releases: a sharp string snap, the arrow leaves.

00:16-00:18 THE ICE WALL
Vertical wide shot from the side, the whole bog in frame: the hero in her ice armour on the left bank, the two elves on the right, about 25 m apart, the same screen sides as the spear flight. The arrow flies in a flat line from right to left toward her. She stands still, then sweeps both arms wide apart to the sides in one powerful motion: frost races out of her hands across the ground and a wall of thick, jagged, translucent ice erupts from the bog in front of her, about 3 m tall and 3 m wide. A split second later the arrow slams into the wall, the arrowhead biting into the ice, shards flying. The wall stands with the arrow stuck in it.

00:18-00:20 SMILE
Vertical close shot of the hero from the front, her face exactly as in image 1 with her look from image 2, frosted silver hair moving, the top edge of the ice wall and the stuck arrow in soft focus at the bottom of the frame. Her arms lower, and she smiles slowly and confidently, her pale blue eyes with a cold light locked on the elves. She holds the look. The video ends here.

SOUND: natural only. Wind in the spruces, drizzle, wet footsteps, soft tinkling of ice. A wet sucking sound as the spear is pulled out, crackling of freezing ice, her breathing and a real strained roar. A heavy ice crack at the throw, a rushing whoosh, a loud whip-crack at the catch with a metallic ring of the gauntlet, then his slow angry breath. A leather creak and a sharp string snap, the arrow's whistle, a deep cracking roar of ice erupting, a hard impact and shattering. No music, narration, voiceover or spoken words.

CONTINUITY:
- vertical 9:16 in every shot; real photographic skin, hair, armour, mud and ice, no CGI look;
- the hero's skin, freckles, face and silver hair match image 1 in every shot, ice only added on top; after the transformation she matches image 2 as real ice, chest covered;
- the elves match images 3 and 4 in every shot; exactly three people; the elves are not visible before 00:09;
- the spear: ICE HEAD DOWN in the mud at the start, pulled up out of the mud, ICE HEAD UP in her hand, ICE HEAD FORWARD in the throw and the flight; its shaft stays dark wood and its head stays the glassy ice shard with the blue slit-pupil eye in every shot, including in the elf man's hand;
- the spear flies in one straight line at the elf woman's chest and is stopped in the air before it touches her; the man is beside her, not the target; nobody is hit, no blood;
- the arrow flies at the hero and is stopped by the ice wall before touching her; frozen puddles, ice sheets and the wall only grow, never melt back;
- fixed order: walk up, grip, transformation, roar, throw, spear at her chest, catch, reveal, anger, arrow, ice wall, smile, each once;
- same grey overcast light, fog and bog in all shots; the camera is never seen.

No repeated attempts, slow motion, teleportation, duplicated people, other characters, silhouettes in the fog, banners, collage layouts, inset panels, outfit changes before the transformation, CGI, game-engine or 3D render look, plastic or airbrushed skin, blue or pale painted skin, doll faces, glowing neon eyes or armour, exposed chest, heels on the hero, fur, symmetrical star-pattern cracks, sinking into the mud, gore, wounds, captions, subtitles, text overlays, watermarks, recording interface.

[0–6s] — HUMILIATION
Begin with a close-up of the protagonist holding her iPhone 17 Pro Max near her waist, fingers tense around its edges.
Tilt up to her frightened face as she stands close to the recessed lockers. The leader approaches, filming her vertically with another iPhone 17 Pro Max. Three girls follow, smirking.

LEADER, mocking:
“Go on. Tell them you’re scared.”

The protagonist looks toward the phone lens.

GIRL, quietly:
“Stop filming me.”
She slips her own phone securely into her blazer pocket. The leader lowers her recording phone slightly, maintaining a hostile smile.

[6–10s] — AWAKENING
Medium profile two-shot. Holding her phone in her left hand, the leader raises her right hand to slap the protagonist.

The protagonist raises an open palm.
The attacking hand stops inches from her face, suspended against an invisible barrier. Sound briefly muffles. The pendant glows softly; warm golden light reflects in the protagonist’s dark eyes.

GIRL, firmly:
“Enough.”

A compact crimson-gold pulse pushes the leader backward. She strikes the locker bank shoulder-first and drops into a seated position, stunned. Her phone slips onto the floor beside her.
[10–16s] — FIRST DEFENCE
Wide shot establishes the protagonist and the three approaching girls within the same corridor.

The first girl lunges. The protagonist turns her palm outward, sending a controlled wave that pushes her sideways against the lockers.

The second reaches for the protagonist’s shoulder. A brief golden barrier interrupts the grab and sends her stumbling backward.
The third rushes from farther down the corridor. A low outward sweep of the protagonist’s hand drives her backward across the marble until she lands seated.

Show each action separately, with a clear connection between gesture, energy pulse, and physical reaction. Keep the movements forceful but believable.

Her hair and blazer move with each pressure wave. Gold particles trace her hand movements briefly, then fade.

[16–22s] — DURGA-INSPIRED REVEAL
Close-up of her feet planting firmly. Cut to her face: fear has settled into focused courage.
The leader begins to rise in the background, but stops as the light around the protagonist intensifies.

A restrained crimson-gold aura gathers behind the protagonist’s shoulders. For one brief moment, an abstract trident-shaped pattern appears within the backlight—an impression formed from light and drifting particles.

Loose event programmes lift from the nearby desk and circle through the corridor. Her hair moves in the growing pressure.
One of the girls makes a final attempt to approach. The protagonist turns a single open palm toward her. A translucent golden shield flashes briefly, stopping her advance and pushing her safely back.

Use a slow, controlled camera arc. Hold long enough to read the protagonist’s expression and the divine symbolism.

[22–27s] — FINAL WARNING
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the leader, blurred in the foreground. The protagonist stands in the centre of the corridor, framed by the luxurious school architecture.

GIRL, calm and unwavering:
“You don’t get to hurt me.”

She extends both palms.

One broad crimson-gold shockwave travels down the corridor. Locker doors rattle. Loose papers sweep toward the lens. The girls stagger backward and remain down or seated along the corridor edges.

The wave carries a momentary trident-like pattern within its centre, then dissolves into warm golden particles. Fine dust and flying paper briefly obscure the camera.
[27–30s] — QUIET STRENGTH
The paper clears the lens. The protagonist stands upright at the centre of the corridor, composed, breathing steadily.

Her aura fades. The pendant returns to normal. Her hair settles against her blazer.

She lowers both hands. Her iPhone remains securely in her pocket. The leader’s phone lies beside the leader in the background.

Slow, subtle push-in toward the protagonist’s face. She looks at the girls with firm, quiet resolve. No smile, no victory pose.

End on stillness.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Premium Indian supernatural thriller. Luxurious architecture, contemporary Indian fashion, authentic Indian faces, realistic brown skin tones. Cool-neutral school interiors contrasted with crimson-and-gold divine light. Shallow depth of field for emotional close-ups; deeper focus for action geography. Preserve screen direction, character positions, phone placement, and damage continuity.

SOUND:
English dialogue only, accurate lip sync, no voiceover. Begin with footsteps, faint laughter, and quiet indoor ambience. Build a restrained low synth score with deep percussion. Introduce a single soft temple-bell resonance as the power awakens. Layer pressure waves, metallic impacts, shoe friction, and fluttering paper. Keep dialogue clear. End with quiet breathing and settling paper.
AVOID:
Extra physical arms, distorted hands, cartoon effects, excessive neon light, sexualised school styling, wardrobe changes, duplicated characters, graphic injuries, exaggerated accents, random explosions, unreadable phone-screen close-ups, text overlays, subtitles, or watermark.

30秒、横長4:3。柔らかいアニメ調、繊細な線、暖かいパステルカラー、柔らかい水彩の背景。Image1を一貫したキャラクター「ひなた」として使う（アホ毛が一本ある明るい茶色のふわっとしたボブ、琥珀色の瞳、細い赤リボンの白いブラウス、ピンクのエプロンワンピース）。Image2を一貫したキャラクター「のどか」として使う（青いシュシュで低く一つ結びにした長いこげ茶の髪、青紫の瞳、クリーム色のカーディガン、セージグリーンのワンピース）。Image3を一貫したキャラクター「テン」として使う（四足歩行のテン、ベージュの毛、白い胸、こげ茶の足と耳のふち、青い目、額に青いひし形の模様、毛先が白い大きなふさふさの尻尾、首に青い紐と銀のメダル）。場所は全ショット同じ、大きな古木と緑の木漏れ日のあるファンタジーの森。位置関係は全ショット共通：ひなたは画面左、のどかは画面右に立ち、テンは二人の前の地面に座っている。誰もカメラを見ない。
00–03秒：ひなたImage1のバストアップ、斜め横向き。足元のテンを見下ろし、不安そうに首をかしげて話しかける。カメラ固定。
カットして03–08秒：テンImage3の寄り、斜め上を向いて二人を見上げる。半目で胸を張り、少し偉そうに話す。カメラ固定。
カットして08–10秒：ひなたのバストアップ、斜め横向き。テンを見下ろしたまま、目を丸くして聞き返す。カメラ固定。
カットして10–14秒：テンの寄り。二人を見上げたまま、あきれた顔でゆっくり首を横に振りながら話す。カメラ固定。
カットして14–15.5秒：ひなたのバストアップ。口を開けたまま、真っ白になったように固まる。カメラ固定。
カットして15.5–22秒：のどかImage2のバストアップ、斜め横向き。画面左にいるひなたの方を見て、片手を頬に当て、のんびりにこにこしながら話す。カメラ固定。
カットして22–27秒：二人のミディアムショット、横から。画面左のひなたが画面右ののどかの両肩をつかみ、前後に揺さぶりながら慌てて話す。ひなたの頭の横に青い汗のしずく。のどかは揺さぶられながらも、にこにこ笑ったまま。カメラ固定。
カットして27–30秒：横からの引きの画。画面左のひなたはのどかの肩をつかんだまま、画面右ののどかは目を閉じにこにこしたまま首をかしげている。最後の1.5秒はそのまま止まる。カメラ固定。
音声：00秒 ひなた（不安そうに）「ねぇ、ここはどこなの？」／03秒 テン（落ち着いた、少し偉そうな声で）「ここはルナリス王国じゃ。しらないのか？」／08秒 ひなた（驚いて）「日本じゃなくて？」／10秒 テン（あきれた声で）「日本なんて国、この世界にはない」／14秒 「ガーン」という短い効果音／15.5秒 のどか（のんびり穏やかに）「あらあら。ひなたちゃん、どうやら異世界にまよいこんだみたいね」／22秒 ひなた（慌てて早口で）「のどかちゃん、なんでそんなにおちついてるの？」、揺さぶる「ゆさゆさ」という効果音／環境音：全体に小鳥のさえずりと葉のざわめき／音楽：のどかな森の曲、14秒で止めて15.5秒から再開。
守ること：全ショットで三人の顔、髪型、服装、テンの額の模様と尻尾を変えない。位置関係（ひなたは画面左、のどかは画面右、テンは足元）を変えない。
避けること：カメラ目線、顔の崩れ、服装の変化、余計な人物や動物、画面内の文字や字幕。

"画面 (VISUALS)：
全局摄影与风格指导： 高质量、惊悚的真人电影级恐怖风格。宽高比为 1:1 正方形。灯光营造出一种压抑、令人产生幽闭恐惧的混合氛围，交织着闪烁的中性白色 LED 灯与刺眼、脉冲式的琥珀色及血红色应急频闪灯，极力凸显深夜地铁站环境中的恐惧与孤立感。视觉美学优先考虑深邃、漆黑的阴影，以及银色金属装置和浅中性灰色瓷砖墙上高对比度的湿润反光。摄影完全避免停滞、重复的背部跟拍，而是采用高度动态、充满动感的手法，不断改变速度、屏幕方向和摄像机位置，以营造一种不可预测、令人恐惧的动作起伏感。快速移动时的物理运动模糊、大气雾感以及极具冲击力的照片级逼真水体物理效果至关重要。主角是 @image1（一位金发女性）。在所有镜头中，请保持完全相同的人物和发型，不可有任何偏差。
场景 1 (Scene 1)： 高角度对角线俯视全景，捕捉地下灾难瞬间爆发的庞大规模。一股巨大、骇人的浑浊洪水——夹杂着翻滚的黑色泥浆、看不见的碎片和白色泡沫——从左后方的地铁站台猛烈喷涌而出，将车站的死寂瞬间粉碎。在画面的中左侧，@image1 立即做出反应，带着绝对的、双眼圆睁的绝望，向远处最右侧漆黑的应急竖井全速狂奔。该镜头在一个极具不祥预兆的混乱画面中，瞬间确立了压倒性的环境威胁、主角的脆弱性以及唯一一条极其危险的逃生路线。
场景 2 (Scene 2)： 沿着 @image1 平行移动的低角度对角线跟拍，捕捉她以极高速度、惊恐万分地冲向一排金属闸机。她没有盲目地用身体撞击障碍物；相反，完全凭借肾上腺素的爆发，她将脚重重地踩在湿滑的瓷砖上猛力蹬起，完成了一个极其拼命的、全身越过闸机的腾空动作。摄像机在起跳至跳跃最高点的过程中运用了短暂而高度风格化的慢动作效果，在闪烁的红色应急灯背景下清晰地定格了她悬空的姿态。就在她即将落地的前一瞬，画面猛然恢复实时速度，极大地强调了她落地时那沉重、震颤的物理冲击力。就在她双脚触地的瞬间，身后汹涌的浑浊洪水彻底吞噬了闸机，狂暴地扭曲并折断了沉重的金属。
场景 3 (Scene 3)： 极具威胁感地贴近地面的低角度固定镜头，直指一扇沉重、正在快速下降的钢制防水卷帘门。@image1 从惊慌失措的狂奔完美过渡为在被水淹没的地板上进行低姿态、摩擦式的滑铲，拼命将自己推过迅速缩小的缝隙。就在她的脚尖掠过门槛的绝对瞬间，巨大的钢制卷帘门带着毁灭性的最终冲击力猛砸在混凝土地面上，暂时将恐怖封锁在了门后。
场景 4 (Scene 4)： 短促的近乎头顶上方的跟拍。车站的结构完整性全面崩溃。混凝土地板在她的脚后跟后方仅几英寸处不断碎裂、塌陷，坠入黑暗咆哮的深渊。@image1 突然改变轨迹，从画面的左下角转向右上角，极其惊险地斜向跃至一块暂时稳定的残存地板上。她刚刚蹬地的那个位置立刻崩塌，被黑暗无情吞没。
场景 5 (Scene 5)： 一块巨大、沉重的天花板指示牌从其加固支架上撕裂，斜向砸向地面，眼看就要将她压碎并彻底封死通道。在完全没有减速或打破狂奔节奏的情况下，@image1 在即将遭受致命撞击的前一刻完成了一个极其利落的 90 度急转，将全身抛入一条狭窄、令人窒息的侧面维修通道。摄像机在她穿过镜头的瞬间执行了一个暴烈的快速甩镜头（whip-pan），极具侵略性地强调了方向的突变以及这条黑暗新隧道的强烈幽闭恐惧感。几分之一秒后，巨大的指示牌在她身后重重砸在地上，将主通道彻底埋葬在黑暗和浓重的灰尘之中。
场景 6 (Scene 6)： 涵盖垂直应急竖井整个底部的低角度固定全景。就在 @image1 抵达生锈爬梯的瞬间，她刚才避开的那扇钢制卷帘门在极度反常的巨大水压下发生扭曲并向外炸裂。一堵巨大的浑浊水墙，夹杂着咆哮的白色水花和毁灭性的力量，疯狂涌入这个狭窄的维修空间。她拒绝放弃，利用最后一步冲刺的惯性，将自己猛地抛向生锈的金属横档。洪水猛烈地撞击她下方的墙壁，翻滚的水面极度危险地逼近她的脚部，仿佛一个活着、挣扎着的怪物，企图将她拖入深渊。
场景 7 (Scene 7)： 极高角度俯拍，从上方出口处垂直向下俯视深邃、黑暗的应急竖井。@image1 保持着疯狂向上的势头，以极其消耗体力的极速攀爬着垂直爬梯。摄像机随着她的进度快速向上后退，而下方黑暗中反常且快速上涨的水位正狂暴地追赶着她，在骇人的巨浪中吞没了一根又一根横档。她终于够到了上方唯一一个敞开的矩形维修舱口，拼命用双手死死抓住湿滑的混凝土边缘。镜头在她头部和肩膀破水而出、突破地表的那一确切瞬间切断。
场景 8 (Scene 8)： 深夜里一条荒凉、被雨水打湿的柏油路的低角度广角镜头。这里的灯光与地下的环境形成强烈对比，清晰地分离了背光的明亮白色雨滴与头顶路灯散发的温暖却病态的光晕。@image1 带着绝望的惯性从那个矩形维修舱口猛冲而出，将身体狠狠地摔在湿滑的路面上。她立即连滚带爬地站起来，头也不回地冲进倾盆大雨中，保持着极度惊恐的逃生姿态。就在这千钧一发之际，一道高压、巨大的黑色水柱从她身后的同一个舱口垂直喷发，在夜空下的道路上猛烈爆炸成巨大的、反常的白色水雾间歇泉。她迅速跑出画面，向着黑暗、多雨的阴影处斜向狂奔。
场景 9 (Scene 9)： 缓慢的跟拍全景。@image1 在一条废弃、昏暗的城市小巷中气喘吁吁地狂奔，倾盆大雨将她浑身湿透。她终于放慢了脚步，重重地靠在一堵潮湿、斑驳的砖墙上，大口喘息着，似乎以为自己已经逃脱了那场地下的噩梦。突然，她脚边深深的水坑开始剧烈震动，泛起一种极其反常频率的涟漪。一个巨大且令人窒息的阴影笼罩了整条小巷。摄像机充满恐惧地、缓慢地向上倾斜，揭示出从舱口喷发出的巨大水柱并没有落回地面——它在半空中凝聚并冻结，完全违背了地心引力。这团庞大的液体开始缓慢地扭曲、拉伸、变形，最终化作一个参差不齐、没有面孔的人形怪物，数百英尺高地耸立在城市天际线之上。这个实体缓慢地低下它巨大的、水构成的头颅，将其不可见、充满恶意的目光直接锁定在瘫痪、极度恐惧的 @image1 身上，随后缓缓举起一只巨大的手，企图将整个街区碾成粉末。
音效与对话 (AUDIO & DIALOGUE)：
全局音频指导： 音频环境的基调是一段快速、极具攻击性的电影级打击乐配乐，它随着局势的不断恶化而无情地增强。声音设计刻意将特定、具有强烈冲击力的音效推至混音的最前台，在关键动作（落地、撞击、汹涌的洪水）发生时大幅压过音乐，以极大地提升主角那种发自肺腑的恐慌、震惊与孤立感。
场景 1 音效 (Scene 1 SFX)： 远处传来金属结构因受力而发出的不祥呻吟声，紧接着是震耳欲聋、爆炸般的轰鸣——巨大的主水管破裂，混凝土在巨大的压力下猛烈碎裂。
场景 2 音效 (Scene 2 SFX)： 湿鞋在光滑瓷砖上打滑时发出的急促、疯狂的吱吱声。在短暂的慢动作跨越期间，音频音量极具侵略性地骤降，只剩下 @image1 沉重、沉闷且充满恐惧的心跳声。落地时，一声极其清脆、震荡的沉闷“砰”声回荡开来，紧接着是金属闸机被汹涌的洪水连根拔起时发出的极其暴烈、撕裂般的金属尖啸。
场景 3 音效 (Scene 3 SFX)： 身体在潮湿、布满沙砾的地板上滑行时发出的刺耳、令人痛苦的金属摩擦声。该场景结束于一声极其可怖、震耳欲聋的回声巨响（SLAM）——沉重的钢制卷帘门砸向地面，引发了一阵震动低频的深沉轰鸣。
场景 4 音效 (Scene 4 SFX)： 持续、深沉、灾难性的隆隆声震动着整个声场。厚重的混凝土像脆弱的骨头一样断裂并发出的清脆断裂声，随后是它们坠入似乎无底深渊的声响。
场景 5 音效 (Scene 5 SFX)： 天花板上固定金属螺栓断裂时发出的高频尖啸声。指示牌砸在地板上引发了一阵仿佛能震碎骨头的巨大撞击声（CRASH），彻底主导了混音，并粗暴地切断了她身后回荡的车站环境音，取而代之的瞬间是狭窄维修通道里那种紧绷、死寂且令人幽闭恐惧的声学环境。
场景 6 音效 (Scene 6 SFX)： 加固卷帘门发生灾难性失效时发出的一声突兀、爆炸性的轰鸣（BOOM）。高压水流涌入狭小封闭空间时那种震耳欲聋、汹涌澎湃的轰隆声，被严重扭曲，听起来几乎像是某种巨大野兽从喉咙深处发出的咆哮。她的手脚拼命抓住金属梯子横档时发出的尖锐、疯狂的铿锵声。

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, 30 seconds, ultra-realistic cinematic Korean school action drama, 24 FPS, natural motion, professional film cinematography.

MAIN OBJECTIVE:
Recreate a realistic Korean high-school action sequence featuring a long-haired female student who stands up to school bullies and protects a younger, shy schoolgirl. Follow the scene progression, character movements, facial expressions, fight choreography, camera angles, lighting, and emotional ending described below. Maintain strict character consistency throughout the entire video.

CHARACTER DESIGN AND CONSISTENCY

Character 1 — Main Female Protagonist:
A young Korean high-school girl with long, straight black hair, a serious expression, and a confident, fearless personality. She wears a dark navy school blazer with cream-colored sleeves, a white shirt, a red ribbon tie, a gray pleated school skirt, white socks, and white sneakers. Her hair moves naturally during the fight. Preserve her face, hairstyle, body proportions, and outfit in every shot.

Character 2 — Larger Male Bully:
A heavyset Korean high-school boy with short black hair, wearing a white short-sleeved school shirt, a loosely worn dark red and navy striped tie, dark trousers, and black shoes. He carries a blue school backpack and initially behaves arrogantly toward the younger student.

Character 3 — Athletic Male Fighter:
A muscular young Korean man with short dark hair, wearing a dark sleeveless athletic shirt, dark trousers, and sneakers. He becomes involved in the classroom fight.

Character 4 — Younger Female Student:
A petite Korean schoolgirl with a short black bob haircut and round glasses. She wears a gray school uniform, white shirt, dark tie, knee-length skirt, white socks, and black shoes. She appears nervous and vulnerable at first.

Background Students:
A few Korean students in traditional school uniforms watch the confrontation from around the classroom. Their reactions remain natural and consistent.

SCENE 1 — THE BULLYING (0–4 SECONDS)

Open inside a spacious Korean high-school classroom during the late afternoon.

Large windows line one side of the classroom, revealing a distant city skyline. Warm sunlight enters through the windows. Wooden desks and chairs are arranged in rows, and a large green chalkboard covers the front wall.

The younger girl sits beside a desk, looking uncomfortable and frightened. The larger male student stands beside her, holding her blue backpack. He takes the bag away from her while she tries to retrieve it.

Show a close-up of the blue backpack and a pink pencil case lying on the classroom floor. The younger girl looks down helplessly.

The male bully smiles arrogantly while holding the backpack.

Use natural classroom ambience, realistic body movements, and cinematic medium shots.

SCENE 2 — THE CONFRONTATION (4–8 SECONDS)

The long-haired female protagonist enters the confrontation and faces the larger male student.

She stands upright with a cold, determined expression. Her eyes remain fixed on him.

The bully turns toward her and approaches aggressively, gesturing with his free hand.

Other students watch from a distance.

Use alternating medium shots and close-ups to emphasize the contrast between his arrogance and her calm confidence.

Keep the classroom layout, sunlight direction, and character positions consistent.

SCENE 3 — THE FIRST FIGHT (8–14 SECONDS)

The larger male student suddenly lunges toward the female protagonist.

She reacts quickly, dodging his attack and moving sideways.

Her long black hair swings naturally as she avoids his strike.

She loses her balance momentarily and drops toward the classroom floor, supporting herself with one hand. The bully moves past her while attempting to continue the attack.

Show a low-angle action shot as she performs a controlled defensive movement, extending her leg to keep him away.

Use realistic fight choreography, believable momentum, accurate body mechanics, and carefully timed movements.

Desks and chairs remain stationary unless physically contacted.

Avoid exaggerated superhuman movements.

SCENE 4 — THE FIGHT ESCALATES (14–20 SECONDS)

The confrontation intensifies as the athletic male fighter enters the action.

The female protagonist gets back on her feet and faces the attackers.

The larger bully and the athletic fighter move aggressively toward her from different positions.

She blocks an incoming strike, turns her body, and uses a fast defensive counterattack.

Her hair and blazer move naturally with every turn.

Show a wider shot of the classroom as the fight moves between rows of wooden desks.

Use quick cinematic cuts between the fighters, their footwork, their facial expressions, and their defensive movements.

Keep the choreography visually clear, with no teleporting, duplicated characters, or unnatural limb movements.

SCENE 5 — THE SIGNATURE KICK (20–24 SECONDS)

The female protagonist faces the athletic male fighter.

She pivots on one foot and launches a fast, controlled high kick toward his upper body.

Capture the kick in a dramatic wide-angle shot, clearly showing her full body, extended leg, and the opponent reacting to the movement.

Her long hair flows through the air, and her school uniform moves naturally.

The athletic fighter recoils and loses his balance.

The larger bully remains visible in the background, reacting to the fight.

Use realistic contact timing, cinematic motion, natural gravity, and a brief slow-motion accent at the peak of the kick.

The action must remain physically believable.

SCENE 6 — THE BACKPACK MOMENT (24–27 SECONDS)

The action settles.

Show the blue school backpack near the feet of the students.

The main female protagonist turns away from the confrontation and approaches the younger girl.

She gently retrieves or picks up the blue backpack and returns it to the younger student.

The younger girl looks relieved.

Use a close-up of the backpack being handed back, followed by a medium shot showing the two girls together.

The emotional contrast between the earlier bullying and the quiet gesture of kindness should be clear.

SCENE 7 — THE FINAL SHOT (27–30 SECONDS)

End with a cinematic wide shot from the back of the classroom.

Rows of wooden desks create leading lines toward the green chalkboard and the large sunlit windows.

The main female protagonist stands beside the younger girl, calm and composed after the confrontation.

The other students remain scattered around the classroom.

The camera slowly pulls back through the rows of desks, leaving the two girls visible in the distance.

Finish with a serious, emotionally satisfying Korean action-drama atmosphere.

No additional fight, no sudden location change, and no unnecessary ending scene.

VISUAL STYLE

Ultra-realistic live-action appearance, Korean high-school action-drama cinematography, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, detailed school uniforms, physically accurate movement, warm late-afternoon sunlight, soft shadows, cinematic depth of field, realistic motion blur, natural hair movement, and professional action-scene editing.

Maintain a consistent color palette of warm sunlight, neutral classroom tones, navy uniforms, and natural skin colors.

CAMERA DIRECTION

Use a cinematic combination of:

- Wide shots establishing the classroom.
- Medium shots showing interactions between characters.
- Close-ups of facial expressions.
- Low-angle shots during defensive movements.
- Side-angle tracking shots during the fight.
- A brief slow-motion moment during the signature kick.
- A slow backward camera movement for the final shot.

All camera movements should be smooth and intentional.

AUDIO DESIGN

Use realistic classroom ambience, footsteps, clothing movement, desk-chair sounds, and subtle cinematic action sound effects.

Add a tense instrumental action-drama soundtrack that builds during the confrontation and softens during the backpack scene.

No unnecessary dialogue, no narration, and no distracting sound effects.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

No character identity changes, no face swapping, no hairstyle changes, no costume changes, no duplicated characters, no extra fingers, no distorted hands, no broken limbs, no floating bodies, no impossible martial arts movements, no unnatural physics, no excessive camera shake, no random scene transitions, no changing classroom layout, no inconsistent lighting, no flickering faces, no artificial plastic skin, no cartoon appearance, no anime style, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, and no watermarks.

FINAL REQUIREMENT: Preserve the sequence of events, the Korean school setting, the blue backpack, the female protagonist's defensive fighting style, the signature kick, and the final act of kindness. Prioritize consistent characters, coherent action, realistic motion, and cinematic storytelling throughout the 30-second video.

「身份锁定｜施法者」约四十五岁的成年男性，身材高瘦，穿一件古老厚重的深炭褐色羊毛兜帽长袍，袍边磨损破旧，腰间系一条旧皮带；兜帽始终戴着，阴影遮住他的眼睛和上半张脸，只露出鼻尖、灰黑色短胡须和嘴唇；手持一根精致的魔杖：深色木头制成，长约三十厘米，只有铅笔粗细，笔直纤细，从握柄到杖尖逐渐收细成一个尖端，握柄处有简单的雕刻纹路和一圈细银环；他像握笔一样用手指轻轻捏着它。魔杖不是树枝、木棍、棍棒、手杖或法杖，没有节瘤、分叉、疙瘩或粗大的球头，长度不超过他的前臂。他是全片唯一穿深炭褐色兜帽长袍的人，只出现在SHOT 1与SHOT 2；全程同一人，不复制。 「身份锁定｜巨蛇」同一条巨蛇：全身覆盖哑光近黑色的大块鳞片，鳞片边缘在火光下有细微的暗铜色反光，腹部是一排暗炭灰色的横向宽鳞；头部宽大呈楔形，眉骨和头顶上有一排向后排列的短尖骨刺状鳞片；两只琥珀黄色的发光眼睛，黑色竖瞳；上颚两根又长又弯的象牙色毒牙，口腔内部粉红色，分叉的黑色舌头；身体又长又粗，没有四肢、翅膀、角或鬃毛，只有一个头和一条尾巴。体型：刚出现时只有手指粗、约半米长；在4.00–8.00秒内连续、均匀地长大；从8.00秒起保持最终巨型体型——身体粗约8米，头部长约12米，抬起头时高过城墙，全长比整座城堡的外墙还长；从8.00秒到结尾体型不再改变。全程只有这一条蛇，不复制、不分裂、不出现第二个头。 「身份锁定｜守城巫师」约十名成年男女巫师，身穿深灰、深蓝与暗酒红色长袍，有的戴兜帽，每人只用一只手握着一根同样精致的浅色木魔杖：长约三十厘米、铅笔粗细、笔直纤细、杖尖收细，杖尖朝前；魔杖不是长棍、手杖、法杖、木剑或树枝，长度不超过前臂；他们的长袍颜色与施法者明显不同。他们不说话，只发出无语言的惊叫与惨叫。 「空间」位置追踪（全片以此为准）：施法者站在城堡南面约四百米外一片起雾的荒野高地上，面向北方的城堡。城堡是一座古老的灰黑色哥特式石砌城堡：南面外墙正中是巨大的城门（厚重的橡木门板与铁栅门，两侧各一支火把），城门后是石板铺地的庭院；庭院北侧中央是高大的方形主堡，是城堡的最高处；庭院东北角是一座约四十米高、带尖顶的圆形塔楼；城墙顶部是带垛口的城墙走道。SHOT 1、2、5、6都从南面朝北拍，因此城堡东侧永远在画面右侧、西侧永远在画面左侧；只有SHOT 3在庭院内从北朝南正对城门拍摄；SHOT 4在南城墙走道上朝东拍，庭院在画面左侧。巨蛇的路线：施法者的魔杖→沿荒野向北→撞破南城门→进入庭院→在南城墙走道旁抬起→缠住东北角圆塔→盘上北侧主堡顶端。城门破洞、倒塌的圆塔、被扫平的城墙、火焰、碎石与倒下的巫师只累积、不复原。 「首帧」50mm侧前方中近景：浓雾中的荒野高地，施法者的右手正从长袍袖中抽出那根铅笔粗细、约三十厘米长的纤细魔杖，兜帽阴影遮住上半张脸，背景远处雾中隐约是城堡的黑色轮廓和几点火把光。 「时间轴」SHOT 1｜0.00–4.00秒｜50mm侧前方中近景，镜头与施法者胸口同高，缓慢推近：0.00–0.80秒施法者从袖中抽出那根纤细的魔杖，像握笔一样捏在指尖，举到胸前，杖尖指向远处的城堡；0.80–3.00秒他的嘴唇靠近杖身，用低沉沙哑的气声缓慢、清晰地耳语那一句拉丁语咒语，只有嘴唇在动，身体保持静止；3.00–4.00秒杖尖慢慢变黑，一条只有手指粗、约半米长的黑色小蛇从杖尖钻出，鳞片闪着微光，沿着魔杖缠上他的手腕，琥珀黄的小眼睛亮起；CUT。SHOT 2｜4.00–8.00秒｜24mm人物高度机位，位于施法者身后右侧，越过他的肩膀朝北拍向城堡：4.00–5.00秒小蛇从他的手腕滑落到湿草地上，向北游入雾中；5.00–8.00秒它一边快速向城堡蜿蜒游去，一边连续、均匀地长大——从手臂粗变成树干粗，再变成塔楼粗，它的脊背像一道长长的黑色山脊从雾中拱起，压倒草地，浓雾被它的身体推开、翻卷；8.00秒时它的头已经抵达远处的南城门，抬起的头与城门楼一样高；施法者始终留在前景静静站着，以他的小体型衬出巨蛇的大小；长大是连续的生长，没有闪光、光柱或跳变；CUT。SHOT Duration: 30 seconds | Format: 9:16 vertical
Style: Photorealistic, high-end live-action Ferrari commercial

EVERY SYSTEM IS UNDER PRESSURE. NOTHING LOSES CONTROL.
Create a professional automotive commercial progressing through Ferrari identity, engineering, acceleration, driver control, braking, cornering, extreme speed and composure.

Use the uploaded professional commercial for realistic camera behavior, natural vibrations, aggressive cropping, motion blur, foreground occlusion and editing rhythm. Do not copy its location or shots.

The footage must feel physically captured, never artificially generated.

REFERENCES
Image 4: Exact F80 front and rear geometry.
Image 3: Side profile, wheelbase and top proportions.
Image 5: Front three-quarter geometry.
Images 2, 6–10: Exact cockpit, seats, steering wheel, dashboard and controls.
Video 1: Supplied video reference. Use only the camera, driving, instrument or sound behavior actually demonstrated.

DRIVER_REFERENCE: Exact face, hair, skin, body, outfit and hands.
LOCATION AND LIGHTING
One continuous northern-Italian mountain road inspired by Lake Garda/Tremosine, without copying an exact location.
Dark limestone walls, wet winding asphalt, stone guardrails, occasional short rock-cut tunnels, Italian vegetation, distant lake views and misty mountain ridges.

Cloudy, slightly dark daylight after light rain. Fine atmospheric moisture, subtle mist, no storm or sunset.

Natural overcast lighting, rich Ferrari red against cool gray-green surroundings, realistic wet-road reflections, water beads, moving body reflections, soft highlights and detailed shadows.

Maintain the same physical road, geography, weather and forward travel direction throughout.

CAMERA AND PHYSICS

Use real automotive camera positions: macro, low rear three-quarter, side tracking, interior shoulder, restrained aerial, wheel detail, low front three-quarter and fixed roadside.

Camera vibration must be physically motivated by engine pulses, asphalt, suspension, airflow or close vehicle movement. Chase rigs retain minor framing drift; aerial and fixed cameras remain stable.

No whip pans, impossible orbits, floating cameras or constant artificial shaking.

Show speed through road parallax, rotating wheels, changing reflections, suspension response, directional motion blur and sound. Keep the Ferrari readable.

Realistic mass, tire loading, grip, braking weight transfer, suspension compression, countersteering and progressive acceleration. Never weightless or exaggerated.

EXACT 30-SECOND TIMELINE

00:00–00:02.2 | SHOT 1: MECHANICAL IDENTITY

Four rapid details:

0–0.55s: 85mm exhaust/diffuser macro. Wet carbon, vibrating droplets, engine ignition.

0.55–1.10s: Ferrari front badge, wet red paint, moving reflection.
1.10–1.60s: Wheel emblem, brake rotor and caliper, initial mechanical engagement.

1.60–2.20s: Interior steering-wheel emblem and driver's hand. Subtle engine vibration.

Clean cuts synchronized with mechanical sounds.
00:02.2–00:05.0 | SHOT 2: RELEASE
40–50mm low rear three-quarter, camera 25cm above asphalt.
Ferrari dominates the midground against rock and vegetation. Engine rises; rear suspension settles slightly as the car accelerates.

Correct wheel rotation, progressive traction, subtle road spray and body vibration.

Camera remains nearly stationary initially, allowing the car to move out of frame. Strong acceleration audio.
00:05.0–00:08.0 | SHOT 3: SIDE SPEED

40–50mm matched-speed tracking at wheel height, approximately 1.5–2m from the car.

Ferrari remains relatively sharp; foreground vegetation streaks past while distant scenery moves slowly.

Show accurate side sculpture, wheel rotation, tire contact, suspension travel, moving reflections and light road spray.

Allow minor road-induced vertical vibration and natural framing drift.

00:08.0–00:09.2 | SHOT 4: DRIVER
50–70mm interior shoulder camera.

Exact driver identity. Focused eyes, natural hands, slight steering correction, restrained facial tension and realistic body response.

Dark cockpit, moving road outside, dashboard visible but secondary.

00:09.2–00:12.0 | SHOT 5: ROAD GEOGRAPHY

Restrained near-top-down aerial revealing one connected S-shaped mountain road, rock wall, distant lake/valley and Ferrari trajectory.

Follow gently without orbiting. Preserve realistic road layout and vehicle direction.
00:12.0–00:13.6 | SHOT 6A: BRAKING

Extreme front-wheel close-up at hub height.

Rotating wheel, fixed caliper, working brake assembly, front suspension loading, tire contact and fine water spray.

No frozen wheel or artificial glowing brakes.

00:13.6–00:15.0 | SHOT 6B: TURN-IN
50–65mm low front three-quarter.

Ferrari enters the bend cleanly. Correct steering angle, restrained body loading, stable tire grip and natural wet-road reflections.

Establish grip before the drift.

00:15.0–00:19.0 | SHOT 7: CONTROLLED ROTATION
Begin with low rear three-quarter as the Ferrari enters a stronger curve.

The rear briefly steps outward.

Cut precisely when the slip becomes visible to a wide elevated three-quarter camera, continuing the same physical movement.

Show road curvature, modest rear slip, correct countersteer, subtle tire haze, progressive correction and straight exit.

No spinning, donuts, direction reversal or excessive sliding. Camera movement remains restrained.
00:19.0–00:20.0 | SHOT 8: SENSORY DETAILS

Three rapid moving inserts, approximately 0.3 seconds each:

Rear taillight at speed.

Rotating rim and wheel.

Front intake/headlight edge.
Synchronize with engine pulse, gear change and exhaust beat. No static product shots.

00:20.0–00:23.5 | SHOT 9: HIGH-SPEED PASS

100–135mm fixed roadside telephoto.

Ferrari approaches from a distance and rapidly fills the frame, with realistic compressed background perspective.

Close pass creates directional blur, peak engine sound and one subtle physical camera response.

Do not chase or pan after the car.

Hold the empty road approximately 0.5 seconds as mist, moisture, light debris and engine sound settle.
00:23.5–00:30.0 | SHOT 10: FINAL RELEASE

35–50mm sustained lateral tracking along an open Italian mountain road, with wet asphalt, rock, vegetation and distant lake/valley.

Ferrari travels left-to-right in the lower-middle composition.
Keep it stable but not perfectly locked. Allow tiny camera corrections, strong foreground parallax, natural wheel blur, slight spray, suspension response and moving reflections.
No drifting, artificial effects or extra cuts.

Engine reaches its strongest sustained performance note. Music resolves underneath.

In the final second, Ferrari gains slightly on the camera and moves toward the leading third.
Cut to black while the car is moving. Display the official Ferrari emblem and FERRARI wordmark briefly before 30 seconds. Final restrained engine tail, then silence.

SOUND DESIGN

No dialogue or narration.

Ferrari engine and exhaust dominate: ignition, idle, RPM rise, gear shifts, exhaust pulses, tire contact, wet-road spray, wind, braking, cornering scrub and natural ambience.

Music remains secondary. Motivate cuts through acceleration, shifts, braking, tire loading and engine pulses.

Preserve believable engine behavior and change sound perspective with camera position. Do not invent an incorrect powertrain sound.

DASHBOARD ACCURACY
Use supplied cockpit images for exact layout and video references for verified instrument behavior.

Speed increases progressively during acceleration. RPM rises before an upshift, drops afterward and rises again. Braking reduces speed logically.

F80 engine reference limits: maximum power at 8,750 rpm, maximum operating speed 9,000 rpm, dynamic limiter 9,200 rpm.

No random gauges, warning lights, fonts or flickering numbers. If typography cannot remain accurate, keep the cluster slightly out of focus.

ABSOLUTE CONTINUITY

Maintain identical F80 body, red paint, wheels, badges, headlights, interior, driver identity, outfit, road surface, weather, lighting and driving direction.

No mirrored Ferrari, changing road geography, different dashboard, traffic, pedestrians, visible filming equipment, impossible camera movement or inconsistent vehicle physics.

Every shot must feel like another real camera covering the same continuous drive.

FINAL INTENTION: Ferrari F80 communicates pressure, precision and control through believable vehicle mass, tire contact, imperfect but professional camera behavior, natural reflections, mechanical sound and physically convincing performance.

prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic, emotionally devastating cinematic video, approximately 24 seconds, 16:9, 24fps. A post-apocalyptic love story told entirely through visuals, without dialogue. Two infected lovers discover each other inside an abandoned train station. Their bodies have succumbed to the infection, but some forgotten part of them still recognizes the person they loved. A familiar touch awakens fragmented memories of their life together before the world collapsed. The memories feel beautiful, imperfect, and painfully real. The ending returns to the present, revealing that although their humanity is fading, their connection remains.

Visual direction: Photorealistic cinema, natural skin textures, anamorphic lens character, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, realistic handheld movement, soft lens flares, volumetric light, restrained color grading. Present-day scenes feature desaturated green-grey tones, decaying architecture, drifting dust, and cold overcast light. Memories feature warm amber sunlight, rich natural colors, and gentle halation. Emotional restraint over melodrama.

Character continuity — keep identical faces throughout:

Man: Early 30s, short messy dark-brown hair, light stubble, silver curb chain, small silver hoop in his left ear. Present-day appearance: shirtless, dark trousers, ashy grey-green skin, mottled veins, cracked lips, dirt-covered shoulders, bruising around the eyes. His irises are clouded milky-grey, with faintly veined pale sclera and small, dull pupils. His gaze remains subtly responsive. Memory appearance: healthy olive skin, dark charcoal crewneck, warm brown eyes, natural smile.

Woman: Early 30s, long wavy dirty-blonde hair, small silver nose ring, oversized black knit sweater in the present. Her skin is pale and ashy, with realistic discoloration, faint veins, and dark bruising around the eye sockets. Her irises have a cloudy blue-grey film, glassy surfaces, and muted pupils. Memory appearance: healthy skin, heather-grey T-shirt, clear blue-grey eyes, expressive laughter.

Shot-by-shot sequence

0.0–3.0s — The abandoned station

A wide cinematic shot of a deserted railway platform swallowed by weeds. A derailed train rests beneath a broken glass canopy. The infected man sits alone on a rusted bench, staring at an old photograph held between dirty fingers. Wind moves loose paper across the platform. He slowly lifts his head as faint footsteps echo in the distance. His cloudy eyes turn toward the sound. Slow dolly-in, cold green-grey palette, atmospheric silence.

3.0–5.5s — Recognition

At the far end of the platform, the infected woman emerges through drifting mist. Her oversized black sweater hangs loosely from her shoulders, her dirty-blonde hair moving in the wind. She stops beneath a flickering station light. A medium close-up reveals her pale, filmed-over irises and bruised eye sockets. She studies the distant figure as though trying to remember his face. The camera slowly pushes toward her eyes.

5.5–8.0s — The distance between them

Alternating profile shots as they walk toward each other along opposite sides of the platform. Neither moves like a predator. Their steps are uneven and hesitant. The man brushes his fingertips across a rusted metal railing; the woman pauses beside an abandoned child’s bicycle. Their dead eyes remain fixed on one another. A train carriage slides across the foreground, briefly obscuring the frame and revealing them much closer when it clears.

8.0–10.5s — The familiar gesture

They stop face-to-face beneath a shattered station clock. The woman raises one trembling hand and touches the silver chain around his neck, recognizing something familiar. He looks down at her hand, then back into her eyes. His expression barely changes, but his breathing catches faintly. Extreme close-up on their fingers touching the chain, followed by a rack focus to their clouded eyes. No snarling, no sudden movements.

10.5–12.0s — Memory begins

Her thumb brushes the chain.

Match cut to the same gesture in the past: her healthy hand resting against the same silver necklace as the man smiles at her in warm afternoon sunlight. The cold station transforms into a sunlit apartment balcony through a seamless visual transition. The soundtrack remains instrumental, with a delicate piano motif and distant ambient textures.

12.0–14.0s — A life they once had

Memory. The couple stand in a tiny apartment kitchen, cooking together. She playfully steals a piece of food from his plate. He pretends to be offended before breaking into a genuine laugh. Their clear brown and blue-grey eyes reflect the warm window light. Imperfect handheld framing, natural movement, lived-in surroundings, intimate realism rather than polished advertising aesthetics.

14.0–16.0s — The last ordinary day

Memory. They ride a bicycle together along a quiet countryside road at sunset, the woman seated behind him with her arms around his waist. She rests her cheek against his back and closes her eyes. Tall grass sways beside the road. Golden sunlight spills through the trees. The camera follows from behind, creating the feeling of a cherished moment captured before anyone knew it would become a memory.

16.0–18.0s — The world before

A brief, fragmented memory: rain against a bedroom window at night. They lie together beneath a blanket, foreheads touching, smiling quietly. Her fingers trace his cheek while he gently tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. Their eyes are alive, moist, and full of warmth. A lightning flash momentarily illuminates their faces, creating a natural visual bridge to the cold present.

18.0–20.0s — Back to the station

Hard match cut to the same framing in the abandoned station. The woman’s hand is still against his cheek, but the skin beneath her fingers is cracked and grey. Her eyes are cloudy and lifeless in color. His dull milky-grey eyes remain locked on hers. The piano falls away, leaving only wind passing through broken windows and the faint metallic groan of the station.

20.0–22.0s — The almost-human moment

Extreme close-up, both faces filling the frame. The man slowly raises his hand and rests it against the woman’s cheek. A tear-like trace of moisture catches the light beneath her clouded eye, without restoring its color. She leans into his palm by the smallest amount. Their noses almost touch. Fine cracks, subtle veins, dirt, and realistic skin deterioration remain sharply detailed. No supernatural glow, no sudden transformation.

22.0–24.0s — Still together

A wider shot from behind them. They sit side by side on the rusted station bench, hands clasped, facing the abandoned tracks disappearing into the mist. Weeds move in the wind. Far above, the broken canopy lets one narrow beam of golden sunlight fall across their joined hands. The rest of the station remains cold and lifeless. The camera slowly pulls away until they become small figures in the ruined architecture.

End on their clasped hands. Fade to black. No title card.

Cinematography and performance

* Prioritize emotional storytelling through eyes, hands, posture, and subtle facial movement.
* Use motivated match cuts that connect identical gestures, compositions, and character positions across past and present.
* Maintain consistent facial identity, hairstyle, jewelry, clothing, and body proportions in every shot.
* Present-day movement should feel slow, stiff, and physically grounded, with no exaggerated zombie behavior.
* Human memories should feel spontaneous, tender, and imperfect, with believable interactions and natural expressions.
* Use realistic practical infection makeup, restrained discoloration, cracked skin, mottled veins, and bruised sockets.
* Zombie eyes must retain recognizable iris and pupil structure beneath a milky film. Never use glowing eyes, featureless white eyeballs, or black voids.
* Build emotion through visual contrast, ambient sound, and restrained pacing rather than dialogue or excessive effects.

Negative prompt: Cartoon zombies, anime, video-game graphics, plastic skin, exaggerated monster faces, glowing eyes, solid white eyes, black voids, excessive gore, exposed organs, blood splashes, face inconsistency, changing jewelry, changing eye colors in the present, extra fingers, deformed hands, artificial facial expressions, rubbery movement, oversaturated colors, excessive motion blur, random scene transitions, text, subtitles, logos, watermarks.

SCENE 1 — ARRIVAL (0–5s): Handheld camcorder footage follows her into a modest neighborhood salon, showing worn styling chairs, simple mirrors, cluttered counters, old product bottles, Korean magazines, fluorescent lights, and hooded dryers. She greets the stylist and sits down.

No modern equipment, smartphones, luxury interiors, cinematic shots, gimbals, HDR, artificial film grain, VHS distortion, or heavy retro filters.

AUDIO: Natural Korean conversations, salon tools, clicking rods, dryer hum, running water, footsteps, and distant street ambience. No music, cinematic sound design, or scripted narration.

TITLE: THE SCENT THAT AWAKENS THE WORLD
Create a 30-second photorealistic, high-end luxury perfume commercial for an original, fictional fragrance brand. The film must feel like a premium global fashion campaign, with a compelling human story, spectacular visual transformations, elegant movement, and an unforgettable final product reveal.
Format: 30 seconds, 16:9, cinematic 4K quality, realistic skin texture, physically accurate liquid and fabric movement, sophisticated color grading, precise camera movements, premium sound design.

MAIN CHARACTER AND PRODUCT
A striking adult woman with dark hair styled in a loose elegant updo, wearing a flowing champagne-gold silk gown and understated gold jewelry. Her appearance, face, hairstyle, and clothing must remain consistent throughout.
The perfume is a distinctive transparent crystal-glass bottle containing amber liquid, with a sculptural polished-gold cap. Keep its shape and proportions consistent in every shot. The bottle has no logo or readable label.

SCENE 1: THE WORLD HOLDS ITS BREATH (0 to 5 seconds)
Open with a breathtaking wide shot of an elegant European-inspired courtyard at golden hour. Pale stone architecture, tall arches, a reflecting pool, and delicate white flowers create a luxurious setting.
The woman walks through the courtyard as a gentle breeze moves her silk gown. The environment is beautiful but muted, with restrained colors and still flowers.
The camera sweeps past a foreground column and reveals her standing beside the reflecting pool.
She reaches into a small gold evening bag and retrieves the perfume bottle.
Cut to an intimate macro shot of her fingers lifting the gold cap.
Sound: soft wind, distant birds, a delicate musical note.

SCENE 2: THE FIRST SPRAY (5 to 9 seconds)
Extreme close-up of the perfume atomizer.
She presses the nozzle once. A beautifully detailed cloud of fine fragrance mist catches the sunlight, forming a luminous golden veil around her face.
The camera moves through the mist in slow motion.
As the cloud passes across the courtyard, a ripple travels across the reflecting pool against the breeze. White flower petals lift into the air, and tiny golden highlights begin appearing across the stone architecture.
Her eyes close briefly as she breathes in the fragrance.
The moment should feel physically believable before becoming subtly surreal.

SCENE 3: THE IMPOSSIBLE TRANSFORMATION (9 to 15 seconds)
The music rises.
A wave of golden light sweeps across the courtyard from the reflecting pool outward. Wherever it travels, white flowers bloom rapidly along the stone pathways.
The pool transforms into a mirror-like surface reflecting a glowing amber sky. Hundreds of delicate petals spiral around the woman, while ribbons of champagne-colored silk-like fabric flow through the air behind her.
The camera performs a smooth, sweeping orbit as the previously muted environment becomes a spectacular world of gold, ivory, and warm amber.
The woman turns gracefully, her gown flowing naturally. She remains the emotional center of the scene.
Make this the most visually arresting moment of the entire advertisement.

SCENE 4: SHE BECOMES THE MOMENT (15 to 21 seconds)
Transition seamlessly into an enormous open terrace above a breathtaking landscape at sunset.
The woman walks toward the terrace edge. Beyond her, elegant architecture rises above a valley filled with soft golden mist, waterfalls, and reflective waterways.
Petals drift past the camera in the foreground, creating cinematic depth.
A gentle gust lifts the train of her gown. She turns toward the camera with a calm, confident expression.
The camera tracks backward as she approaches, then passes close beside her shoulder to reveal the spectacular landscape behind her.
The atmosphere communicates confidence, beauty, freedom, and quiet power.
No dialogue. Let the visuals carry the emotion.

SCENE 5: THE GOLDEN COLLISION (21 to 26 seconds)
The flowing silk ribbons sweep across the frame and create a natural visual transition.
Cut to a dark, luxurious studio where the perfume bottle stands on a black obsidian pedestal.
A ribbon of amber liquid spirals around the pedestal without touching the bottle. Suspended droplets catch narrow beams of golden light.
The camera circles the bottle in a controlled macro movement, revealing the thickness of the crystal glass, the amber fragrance, and the polished gold cap.
The background transitions from deep black to a rich golden glow as the last floating petals drift past.
Every reflection must look physically realistic. The product should appear tangible, expensive, and beautifully crafted.

SCENE 6: THE ICONIC FINAL FRAME (26 to 30 seconds)
The moving liquid settles into a still, mirror-like surface around the pedestal.
The camera makes one final, slow push toward the bottle. Behind it, a thin arc of golden light forms a luminous halo.
For one brief moment, a reflection of the woman appears in the curved glass, suggesting the dreamlike world seen throughout the film.
The reflection fades naturally as the camera reaches its final position.
Hold on the perfume bottle, centered and sharply focused, with deep black shadows, amber highlights, and elegant negative space for typography.

Add the tagline during editing:
LEAVE A LITTLE MYSTERY.

End with a single delicate glass chime and a clean fade to black.

CINEMATOGRAPHY AND QUALITY
Use a combination of sweeping wide-angle shots, controlled tracking movements, intimate facial close-ups, extreme macro product photography, and smooth match cuts.
Lighting should transition from soft natural daylight to radiant golden-hour light and finally to dramatic luxury studio lighting.
Maintain realistic human anatomy, natural facial expressions, accurate hands, stable product geometry, coherent spatial continuity, and physically plausible fabric, mist, water, and particle movement.
Avoid cartoon-like effects, excessive glitter, random explosions of particles, distorted faces, changing clothing, bottle deformation, artificial-looking skin, shaky camera movements, watermarks, and unwanted text.
The commercial should build from quiet elegance to spectacular visual wonder, then finish with a refined and memorable product shot. The perfume bottle is the symbol of the transformation, but the woman and the world around her are what make the advertisement unforgettable.

SCENE CONTEXT
Dusk in a dense European pine forest under a flat overcast sky. A young woman in a pale grey dress runs away from camera deep into the trees, being hunted by something unseen behind her; she glances back, keeps running, then stops dead in a clearing between the trunks to listen.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@Image 1: master reference for framing, palette, light and the woman. Woman, late 20s, slim, short cropped pink hair, long loose pale grey cotton dress gathered in her right fist, dark ankle boots, faint dark tattoo on her left forearm. 100% matches the reference.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: forest floor of dark moss, low ferns and brown pine needles, slightly raised toward camera.
Midground: the woman on a narrow natural path between straight, bare, near-black pine trunks set in vertical rows.
Background: trunks recede into a deep teal-green haze, fog density 25%, depth fades to near-black at 40 meters. Pale grey-white sky glimpsed in thin slits at the canopy top.
Camera sits behind her on the shadow side, operator axis aligned with her running path. Light falls from above through the canopy, soft and directionless.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Frame 1: the woman already in full stride, back to camera, centered dead in frame, small within the vertical trunks, head turned to her left over her shoulder. Symmetrical center composition: trunks frame her left and right like bars. Everyone and everything moving from frame one.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, 15 seconds total. Cuts only at the specified points, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
0.0s–5.0s — WS, 63° observational wide, rectilinear, clean soft prime character.
5.0s–8.0s — MCU profile, 29° portrait compression, background trunks melt into soft teal bokeh.
8.0s–10.5s — ECU of her boots, 12° tele-detail, low to the ground.
10.5s–15.0s — EWS, 84° wide, the forest swallows her.
No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Gentle handheld at chest height, 1–2 cm breathing tremor, the operator lags half a beat behind her. Low-contrast tonal character with wide latitude, soft highlight roll-off on the sky slits, deep shadows that keep detail in the moss and bark.

ACTION
0.0s–5.0s — She runs away from camera at 12 km/h along the path, right fist hiking the dress above her knees, left arm pumping. At 2.0s she turns her head to her left over her shoulder, eyes searching the trees behind the camera, then snaps her face forward and keeps running. Camera follows at 10 km/h, so she slowly pulls away into depth.
5.0s HARD CUT
5.0s–8.0s — Tracking profile from her left side, camera moving alongside at her speed. Her face in MCU against the passing trunks: mouth open, short hard breaths, her eyes cut sideways back behind her once, then forward to choose the gap between two trunks.
8.0s HARD CUT
8.0s–10.5s — Low ECU on the forest floor: her dark boots strike the moss and needles, kicking up brown needles and small clods of earth, the grey hem whipping past the lens. On the last step the boot plants hard and skids 10 cm to a stop.
10.5s HARD CUT
10.5s–15.0s — Static wide from far behind, low on the ground: she stands frozen in a small clearing, a pale figure centered among black trunks. Her chest heaves. She turns her head slowly to her right, listening. A single branch cracks off-screen to the left. She holds perfectly still. Camera locked off, holds to the end.

PERFORMANCE
ACTING TASK — THE WOMAN (fully invested in her tactic; the work happens in her eyes and ears):
GOAL: put enough trees between herself and the hunter to vanish from his sight.
OBSTACLE: she cannot see him; the forest hides him as well as it hides her. Every noise she makes can give her away.
TACTIC: run while reading the forest behind her — each glance back is a measurement: how close, which direction, has he seen me. When the running becomes too loud, she switches to silence and listens instead of looking.
Moment to moment:
— 2.0s glance back: searches the gaps between trunks for movement, decides "still behind me", turns forward to pick the line of trees.
— 5.0s–8.0s profile: eyes check behind once, then lock onto the darkest gap ahead — choosing where to disappear.
— 10.5s stop: holds her breath to hear better, turns her ear toward the sound, eyes wide open and tracking the darkness on her right.
Skin realism: pale skin with pore-level detail, cold flush on her cheeks and nose tip, fine sweat at the hairline, visible breath vapor in the cool air, short pink hair moving with each stride.
(Safety: gaze always engaged in the task — focused, searching, alive; natural blink cadence.)

PHYSICS
Real body weight in each stride, slight forward lean, boots sinking into soft moss. The cotton dress reacts to wind and running with inertia, the hem swinging and settling. Pine needles scatter and fall back under gravity. Breath vapor drifts and fades within 30 cm.

LIGHTING
Overcast dusk daylight, 6500K cool, filtered down through the canopy as soft top light. Low contrast, no direct sun, no hard shadows. The pale dress is the brightest element in frame and pulls the eye; her face receives soft grey skylight from above. Exposure set for the midtones so the trunks fall to near-black while the moss keeps its green.

COLOR GRADE
Cool, desaturated cyan-teal grade. The near-black trunks carry a deep blue-green in their shadows; the moss and ferns sit in muted bottle green; the haze between the trees becomes a dusty cyan-blue as it recedes; the pale grey dress picks up a sage-cyan tint from the forest light; the brown pine needles on the floor are the only warm note, a muted olive-khaki. The pink hair is the single saturated accent, dimmed into a faded dusty rose by the cold light.

AUDIO
Diegetic only: her rapid breathing, boots thudding on soft earth, needles crunching, fabric rustling. Distant crow call at 6.0s. At 10.5s the forest goes almost silent — only her held breath and wind through the high branches — then one sharp branch crack from the left.

STYLE
Photoreal European arthouse thriller, natural and restrained, fine organic film grain, soft clean optics, quiet and cold atmosphere.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
1.66:1 framing, 24 fps real time for all segments, 15 seconds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same woman, same short pink hair, same pale grey dress and dark boots in every shot. Forest, light and grade identical across all cuts. Hunter remains unseen and off-screen throughout. Overcast dusk light stays constant. She runs away from camera, deeper into the forest, in every wide shot.

Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 cinematic Japanese 2D anime scene. Mature theatrical anime aesthetic, hand-drawn ink outlines, expressive character animation, painted backgrounds, detailed cel shading, dramatic firelight, cool blue-gray shadows, atmospheric smoke and floating embers. No photorealism, no 3D, no game graphics, no subtitles, no narration.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

MARA: Adult athletic woman, approximately 27. Weathered ivory hooded jacket, charcoal combat outfit, dark utility trousers, black gloves, heavy black boots. Matte graphite half-mask with two narrow amber eye openings. Short dark auburn hair, one strand beside her left cheek. Thin ivory fabric strip tied around her left wrist. Calm, precise, controlled movements.

VEX: Adult lean muscular man, approximately 30. Faded burgundy sleeveless jacket over a black compression shirt, dark cargo trousers, fingerless gloves, worn combat boots. Matte black mask with narrow pale painted teeth. Short uneven black hair and a torn burgundy fabric strip attached to his belt. Aggressive, explosive fighting style.

SETTING

A ruined modern city street at night. Cracked asphalt, damaged apartment buildings, a bent streetlamp, a burning dark sedan, drifting smoke and glowing embers. Orange firelight contrasts with cold blue-gray shadows. A damaged wall stands directly behind Mara.

TIMELINE — EXACT ACTION AND CAMERA

0–2 seconds — THE NEAR-MISS

Open immediately on an extremely tight side-angle shot. Vex’s fist rushes past Mara’s cheek, missing by only 2–3 centimeters. Both her face and his fist must remain visible in the same frame so the near-miss is unmistakable. A few strands of her auburn hair whip from the passing force. Mara does not flinch. Sharp air-slicing whoosh, heavy breathing, tense low-frequency impact buildup. No opening establishing shot.

2–5 seconds — THE WALL IMPACT

Vex’s punch continues into the wall directly behind Mara. His fist strikes concrete with a brutal impact. Cracks spread outward from the contact point, fragments break loose, and dust bursts into the air. The camera jolts briefly with the impact. Vex leans forward aggressively.

VEX, low and threatening, in professional English anime dubbing: “You should’ve stayed gone.”

MARA, calm and restrained: “I tried.”

5–9 seconds — CONTROL VS AGGRESSION

Vex attacks again with a fast, forceful combination. Mara evades with minimal, precise movements and counters with a sharp body strike. Every movement has readable weight, clear contact and believable follow-through. Keep both characters identifiable and spatially consistent. Use a brief lateral tracking shot, then a tight impact shot. No teleporting, no random spinning, no excessive motion blur.

GRAVITY ERROR

FORMAT:
16:9 widescreen, 4K, 24fps, total duration 30 seconds. Premium cinematic action, photorealistic, grounded but surreal. Fast close-quarter silat, strong physical impacts, one brief slow motion beat, dynamic camera movement, rich environmental detail, subtle film grain.

WORLD:
A small late-night Jakarta street warung attached to an older ruko. Narrow interior with plastic chairs, metal tables, hanging snacks, instant noodle shelves, bottled drinks, cigarette display, a glass jar of crackers, a rice cooker, a small fan, cheap fluorescent lights, slightly wet tiled floor, cluttered but realistic. Outside the warung is a narrow Jakarta street with parked motorbikes, messy cables, dim streetlights, and humid night air after light rain.

CHARACTER 01:
Lean adult Indonesian man in a dark jacket, plain t-shirt, cargo pants, sneakers. Alert, tense, compact movement, practical street-fight energy.

CHARACTER 02:
Lean adult Indonesian man in a faded overshirt, dark trousers, sandals. Calm but dangerous, quick reflexes, compact silat-inspired movement.

PRIMARY SURREAL RULE:
The first half of the fight is normal.
At the first major impact, gravity inside the warung shifts 90 degrees.
This is not a visual effect only.
The environment physically reorients.
Objects slide and fall sideways.
The fighters must adapt instantly and continue fighting on the wall and tilted surfaces.
The camera remains visually readable and cinematic, not chaotic.

STORY BEAT:
A tense confrontation in a cramped Jakarta warung becomes a surreal gravity-bending fight.

0:00–0:04
Start inside the warung.
Character 01 steps in from the street, breathing slightly hard.
Character 02 is already inside near a metal table, watching him.
The fan hums, fluorescent lights buzz, distant Jakarta traffic outside.
No dialogue yet.
Strong tension.

0:04–0:07
Character 01 says quietly:
“You took the wrong thing.”
Character 02 answers:
“Then come take it back.”
They circle one another in the cramped space.
Camera moves slowly between hanging snack packs and table edges, building pressure.

0:07–0:11
First physical exchange.
A fast shove.
A wrist trap.
Short elbow.
A glass jar rattles.
A chair scrapes across the floor.
Keep the movement compact, believable, and aggressive.
No wasted motion.

0:11–0:14
Character 01 throws a hard right palm strike into Character 02’s chest.
At the moment of impact, the entire warung experiences a gravity shift.
The room rotates 90 degrees.
Chairs, cups, snack packs, a spoon jar, and loose objects slide and fall sideways.
The fighters lose balance for a split second.

0:14–0:18
They recover instantly and continue fighting on what is now effectively the wall.
Character 02 grabs a shelf edge to stabilize himself and counters with a low kick.
Character 01 catches the motion, slams Character 02 into a sideways table.
The camera tilts with the new gravity orientation but stays readable.
The warung now feels impossible yet physical.

0:18–0:22
Fast silat exchange in the gravity-shifted room.
Palm strike.
Parry.
Forearm block.
Shoulder redirect.
Short knee.
Character 01 uses a hanging rack for leverage.
Character 02 pushes off a tilted wall.
A packet display tears loose and floats briefly before dropping sideways with the new gravity.

0:22–0:25
Hero moment.
Both fighters launch toward each other at the same time.
A simultaneous strike nearly lands.
Enter a brief micro slow motion beat.
Dust, instant noodle crumbs, droplets from a tipped drink, and hanging snack wrappers suspend in the air.
Their bodies twist through the warped space.
Hold the slow motion under one second.

0:25–0:28
Snap back to real time.
Character 01 lands a hard redirect and sends Character 02 sliding across the tilted wall toward the warung entrance.
Character 02 stops himself by grabbing the doorframe.
The outside Jakarta street is now visible behind him at a bizarre angle.

0:28–0:30
Gravity suddenly snaps back to normal.
Everything drops.
Tables slam down.
Chairs hit the floor.
Loose items crash.
Both fighters land back on the real floor and freeze for one beat, facing each other.
Camera slowly pulls back through the warung entrance, revealing the cramped Jakarta street outside.
Hard cut to black.

CAMERA:
ARRI Alexa 35 cinematic look.
28mm and 35mm lens language.
Begin with tight, intimate tracking inside the cramped warung.
Use subtle handheld energy during the confrontation.
At the gravity shift, camera adapts with a controlled tilt and reorientation.
Keep motion dynamic but readable.
One brief micro slow motion beat only.
Final move is a smooth pullback out of the entrance.

FIGHT PERFORMANCE:
Compact silat-inspired street fight.
No wide superhero swings.
No exaggerated wire-fu flips.
Efficient palm strikes, elbows, traps, knees, short kicks, redirects, grabs.
The choreography must stay clear and brutal.
Both fighters are skilled and evenly matched.

NATIVE AUDIO:
No background music.
No score.

Use only native sound.
Fluorescent light buzz.
Small electric fan hum.
Distant Jakarta traffic.
Motorbike passing outside.
Table scrape.
Plastic chair drag.
Glass rattle.
Snack pack rustle.
Fabric movement.
Body impacts.
Footsteps on tile.
Objects crashing during the gravity shift.
Short heavy breathing.
The line delivery should sound natural and low-key.

VISUAL STYLE:
Photorealistic cinematic realism.
Humid Jakarta night.
Natural fluorescent and street lighting.
Slight wet reflections.
Cluttered authentic warung texture.
No cyberpunk palette.
No neon sci-fi worldbuilding.
Keep it grounded, dirty, tactile, and physical.

NEGATIVE DIRECTION:
No comedy acting.
No exaggerated anime facial reactions.
No superhero poses.
No floating energy beams.
No magical glowing aura.
No impossible acrobatics.
No gore.
No blood spray.
No slow motion overuse.
No shaky camera mess.
No teleporting.

No futuristic environment.
No sci-fi interface graphics.
