"OBJETIVO
Crear un video cinematográfico de 30 segundos, con tono de parodia épica y tierna, inspirado en la escena clásica de Don Quijote y Sancho contra el molino, pero protagonizado por gatitos. Debe sentirse coherente, fluido y muy consistente entre planos.
REFERENCIAS DE PERSONAJES
Usa únicamente las hojas de personaje adjuntas como referencia visual obligatoria para mantener identidad, vestuario, proporciones y estilo.
[Hoja de personaje 1] Don Quijote gatito caballero. Gatito pequeño grisáceo, armadura de caballero, casco con visera levantada, capa clara, lanza larga estilo Don Quijote. Debe conservar exactamente su diseño de la hoja de personaje.
[Hoja de personaje 2] Sancho Panza gatito escudero. Gatito pequeño, naranja y gordete, con gorro campesino, ropa humilde y bastón. Debe conservar exactamente su diseño de la hoja de personaje.
[Hoja de personaje 3] Ficha de monturas. Don Quijote cabalga el burrito ligeramente más alto. Sancho cabalga el burrito algo más bajo y compacto.
ESTILO VISUAL Y TONO
Cinematográfico, realista pero adorable, con acabado de película. Los gatitos deben verse pequeños y expresivos, con movimiento creíble. Los burritos deben verse algo más realistas que caricaturescos. Tono de parodia tierna, épica y levemente dramática. Sin diálogo. La narración se apoya en actuación, encuadre y timing cómico.
ENTORNO Y ATMÓSFERA
Paisaje inspirado en La Mancha: camino de tierra o sendero rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, pasto amarillento, tierra clara, piedras, horizonte amplio, aire castellano, luz natural. Puede haber una fortaleza o construcciones lejanas muy discretas si ayuda al ambiente, pero no deben verse molinos al inicio ni en los primeros planos. Los molinos deben permanecer ocultos hasta el momento del gag final.
Luz de tarde suave, ligeramente dorada pero no excesiva. Ambiente abierto, algo de viento en el paisaje. El viento debe cobrar más fuerza en el momento heroico de Don Quijote.
REGLAS DE CONSISTENCIA
Mantener el mismo lugar, misma hora del día, misma dirección de la luz y misma continuidad espacial en todos los planos.
Don Quijote siempre va delante y sobre el burrito ligeramente más alto.
Sancho siempre va detrás o un poco más retrasado, sobre el burrito más pequeño.
Don Quijote porta una lanza, no una espada.
Sancho lleva su bastón.
Mantener el mismo diseño exacto de personajes, vestuario, armadura, ropajes y monturas en todos los planos.
No mostrar molinos antes del choque. Solo debe verse el molino después del impacto.
Las transiciones deben sentirse cinematográficas, con cortes limpios y continuidad de dirección.
La comicidad debe surgir del contraste entre la épica de Don Quijote y la realidad del golpe contra el molino.
ESTRUCTURA TEMPORAL EXACTA
Duración total: 30 segundos.
0:00 - 0:05
Plano lateral medio, composición similar a una silueta de Don Quijote y Sancho avanzando de perfil por el camino. Don Quijote va delante sobre su burrito, Sancho detrás en el suyo. Ambos cabalgan tranquilos y cansados. Sancho transmite agotamiento. No se ven molinos. Movimiento suave, paso lento, ambiente sereno.
0:05 - 0:08
Don Quijote se detiene en seco. Su burrito frena. Corte a un primer plano o plano medio corto de Don Quijote deteniendo la montura y mirando fijamente al horizonte con su carita pequeña y muy seria. Debe sentirse que ha percibido algo importante.
0:08 - 0:11
Plano de Sancho. Sancho se ve contrariado y confundido. No entiende por qué se han detenido. Baja torpemente del burrito, todavía cansado, mirando a Don Quijote con desconcierto.
0:11 - 0:15
Plano de Don Quijote ya en el suelo. Ha desmontado. Avanza unos pasos con solemnidad, caminando con su lanza. Entonces una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo desde arriba o desde un lado. Cuando la sombra lo cubre por completo, se detiene.
0:15 - 0:18
Plano heroico de Don Quijote. Se planta recto y quieto, con la lanza erguida, en una pose épica y decidida, inspirada en la pose frontal de su hoja de personaje. El viento sopla con fuerza y hace ondear sutilmente su capa y su pelaje. Debe sentirse como un momento grandioso, exageradamente heroico y un poco ridículo a la vez.
0:18 - 0:22
Primer plano o plano medio corto de Don Quijote en posición de ataque. Se tensa, baja ligeramente el centro de gravedad y arranca de golpe a embestir con toda la determinación del mundo hacia algo que todavía no vemos. La cámara no revela aún el objetivo.
0:22 - 0:26
Plano del impacto. Don Quijote embiste con la lanza contra una pared blanca de molino de viento. El choque es súbito y cómico. Rebota con violencia caricaturesca pero físicamente clara, cae boca arriba al suelo y queda inmóvil unos instantes, como si hubiera perdido el conocimiento.
0:26 - 0:28
Plano más abierto. Ahora sí se revela claramente que Don Quijote está tendido en el suelo, diminuto, delante de un molino de viento blanco tradicional manchego, similar a los de Campo de Criptana. El molino debe verse por primera vez aquí. Sancho puede aparecer al fondo o acercándose, pero sin robar protagonismo.
0:28 - 0:30
Plano final de Sancho, negando con la cabeza, frustrado y contrariado. Debe cerrar con una nota cómica, tierna y digna. Fin.
LENGUAJE DE CÁMARA
Usar lenguaje de cámara cinematográfico y limpio.
Priorizar planos medios, primeros planos expresivos y un plano abierto final para el reveal del molino.
Mantener continuidad lateral clara.
Evitar movimientos de cámara exagerados o caóticos.
Los cortes deben ser elegantes y narrativos.
ACCIÓN Y ACTUACIÓN
Don Quijote debe actuar como un héroe diminuto, serio, idealista y valiente.
Sancho debe actuar como compañero leal, cansado, prudente y confundido.
La actuación facial de ambos debe ser muy importante.
El gag debe sentirse claro: Don Quijote interpreta una amenaza épica donde en realidad hay un molino.
PROMPT MAESTRO
Genera un video cinematográfico de 30 segundos, consistente entre planos, basado en la parodia tierna y épica de Don Quijote y Sancho contra el molino, protagonizada por gatitos. Usa exclusivamente las hojas de personaje adjuntas como referencia obligatoria para Don Quijote gatito caballero, Sancho gatito escudero y sus dos burritos. Mantén exactamente los diseños, vestuario, armadura, ropajes y monturas de las referencias.
Ambientación: paisaje manchego realista, camino rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, hierba amarillenta, piedras, horizonte abierto, atmósfera castellana, luz de tarde suave. No mostrar molinos en los primeros planos ni al inicio. Solo revelar el molino después del choque. Estilo visual realista, cinematográfico, adorable, con burritos algo más realistas y menos caricaturescos. Sin diálogo.
Secuencia:
Plano 1. Plano lateral medio de ambos cabalgando de perfil por el camino, Don Quijote delante sobre el burrito un poco más alto y Sancho detrás sobre el burrito más bajo. Avanzan tranquilos y cansados, especialmente Sancho.
Plano 2. Don Quijote se detiene en seco, frena el burrito y mira fijamente al horizonte con expresión intensa.
Plano 3. Sancho, confundido y contrariado, baja del burrito sin entender qué ocurre.
Plano 4. Don Quijote desmonta y avanza unos pasos con su lanza. Una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo.
Plano 5. Cuando queda completamente cubierto por la sombra, se detiene y adopta una pose heroica, recta y quieta, con la lanza erguida. Sopla un viento fuerte que agita sutilmente su capa y su pelo.
Plano 6. Don Quijote entra en posición de ataque y embiste con decisión hacia un objetivo fuera de cámara.
Plano 7. Se revela el impacto: embiste contra la pared blanca de un molino de viento tradicional manchego, rebota y cae boca arriba al suelo, aturdido.
Plano 8. Plano abierto donde se ve a Don Quijote tumbado delante del molino, diminuto y derrotado.
Plano 9. Plano final de Sancho negando con la cabeza, frustrado, cerrando con humor tierno.
Importante: máxima consistencia visual entre planos, misma localización, misma luz, misma orientación, mismo diseño de personajes. Don Quijote siempre lleva una lanza, no una espada. Sancho mantiene su bastón. El tono debe ser una mezcla de épica, ternura y comedia visual.
10. EVITAR
No mostrar molinos antes del golpe.
No cambiar el diseño de los personajes entre planos.
No volver caricaturescos los burritos.
No hacer movimientos de cámara exagerados.
No introducir elementos modernos.
No convertir la escena en slapstick caótico; debe seguir sintiéndose cinematográfica."

A rapid, beat-driven concert highlight: violet twilight, a huge fan light ocean, FPV flight, vocal close-ups, synchronized dance, fire, cold sparks, gold confetti, and fireworks. Use original fictional faces, styling, choreography, music, light sticks, graphics, and shots. No resemblance to existing performers or groups. Premium world-tour footage with natural motion blur, haze, subtle lens breathing, and volumetric beams.

CHARACTER LOCK
The same five adult women, all in their twenties, remain stable.
Leader: long black hair with one violet streak, silver jacket, black top, pleated skirt, knee boots.
Member two: dark ponytail, white asymmetric top, utility shorts.
Member three: silver-blonde hair, graphite bomber, shimmering skirt.
Member four: short black hair, black-and-white top, metal belt.
Member five: burgundy waves, dark top, wide trousers.

Hair and fabric move with inertia. Microphones remain in their right hands; choreography accommodates them.

LOCATION AND FORMAT
A vast open-air stadium under a blue-violet sky. The main stage sits at the far center; a T-runway enters the crowd. LED walls show violet nebulae, silver pulses, and white geometry. Spark and flame units line the runway outside the performers’ paths. Fans hold original diamond-shaped violet-white light sticks.

Frame one reveals the stadium, runway, stage, and light ocean. Exactly ten seconds, ten concise shots, with HARD, SMASH, MATCH, and WHIP CUTS. Real-time performance: shorten the actions rather than speeding up the bodies. One camera move per shot. Each shot begins with its action already underway.

Preserve geography, identities, outfits, lighting, smoke, and confetti across cuts. No text, logos, flags, UI, watermarks, or brands.

SHOT 1 — 0.0–0.8 SECONDS
107-degree rectilinear FPV ultra-wide, already diving from above the rear stands toward the distant stage through the crowd light ocean. Show a short segment of the flight, not the entire journey. Light sticks pass with strong parallax; architecture stays straight and twilight remains visible.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 0.8–1.6 SECONDS
84-degree low wide skims a short distance along the runway. All five women already form an arrow, leader half a step forward, members two and three behind her, members four and five at the rear corners. Cold sparks ignite on both sides as they snap their heads up on a musical accent.

29-degree short-telephoto portrait makes a small push toward the leader from four meters. She looks into the camera and sings the original non-lexical hook “Oh-ah, hey!” with exact lip sync. Wind carries her violet streak screen-right; sweat, glitter, and earrings catch warm light against violet bokeh. The other four members remain outside this tight crop.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 3.0–4.1 SECONDS
47-degree normal view tracks laterally from front-left, showing all five. They perform one compact original combination: a free-left-arm slice, a shoulder hit, and a grounded crossing step. Boots grip the floor; chains and hair continue moving after the bodies settle.
MATCH CUT on the crossing step.

SHOT 5 — 4.1–4.9 SECONDS
84-degree reverse wide rises slightly behind the group. Continuing the previous movement, all five finish a quarter-turn toward the surrounding audience and lift their microphones outward to invite a response without additional spoken dialogue. A violet-white wave moves through the crowd as searchlights sweep the sky.
HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 — 4.9–5.9 SECONDS
107-degree low ultra-wide makes a short orbit from runway-right. Through one visible traveling step each, the group opens into a diamond with the leader at its center and the other four at its points. Paths remain clear; nobody collides, slides, duplicates, or teleports.
SMASH CUT.

SHOT 7 — 5.9–7.0 SECONDS
84-degree frontal full-body view makes a short push from the stage edge. All five perform a sharp free-arm diagonal, one weighted knee dip, then rise into an open star-like group silhouette. Keep all five bodies distinct and fully grounded.
WHIP CUT.

SHOT 8 — 7.0–7.8 SECONDS
47-degree crowd view tilts upward with fans raising violet-white light sticks. Fans chant “Hey! Hey!” on two consecutive beats. The same five performers remain visible dancing on the distant stage. Keep focus on the foreground fans, with the stage recognizable behind them.

SHOT 9 — 7.8–8.7 SECONDS
107-degree FPV camera races a short distance backward and upward along the runway center. All five complete one upward free-arm hit as cold sparks fire and a brief flame burst illuminates the stage edges. Violet beams cross through the smoke. The crowd light ocean expands while the performers remain readable.

84-degree final frontal wide rises while pulling back in one continuous retreat. The leader takes one step forward with her microphone raised; the other four continue their groove and acknowledge the audience with their free hands.

Bodies obey gravity, friction, balance, and ground contact. Steady wind drives hair, smoke, sparks, and confetti consistently. Pyrotechnics remain separated from performers and spectators. Exactly five group members in every group shot; no extra performers.

人物固定：
女学生18岁，韩国面孔，长黑直发，藏蓝西装校服外套、白衬衣、黑色丝带领结、灰色格纹裙、白色运动鞋，体型纤细。她不怒吼、不摆胜利姿势，视线始终追踪正在接近的威胁。

左侧旧砖墙前堆着空纸箱，右侧停着两辆踏板车，中间通道可供近身搏斗。受困女子靠左墙，女学生从远处巷口走来。搏斗发生在两名女子之间的通道内。纸箱受到撞击后保留散落状态，踏板车位置不变，倒地男子保留实际落点。

提示词在这：
一只高度写实的博美幼犬躲在温馨卧室里柔软的灰色毛毯下面，身下是一张舒适的床，房间充满温暖、柔和的光线。博美幼犬的毛发以纯白色为主，耳朵、额头、脸颊和背部有少量自然的暖金黄色毛发。只有它圆润、蓬松的小脸和一双大大的深棕色眼睛从毛毯下面露出来。
小狗安静地注视着站在手机后面的人。它缓慢眨眼，脑袋轻轻向左、向右歪动。小巧的三角形耳朵微微抖动，胡须自然摆动，小小的黑色鼻子好奇地嗅闻着。
短暂停顿后，小狗慢慢从毛毯下面完全爬出来。它压低身体，摆出准备玩耍扑击的姿势。屁股左右扭动两次，蓬松卷曲的尾巴兴奋地轻轻抽动，瞳孔稍微放大。
毫无预警地，它突然以爆发性的速度直接扑向摄像机。
第一人称视角，摄像机就是观众的手机屏幕。小狗笔直地飞向镜头。即将撞上的一瞬间，它将两只前爪向前伸出，仿佛想要抓住屏幕前的观众。
紧接着——
砰！
小狗一头撞在摄像机前方那块看不见的玻璃上。撞击沉重、有力，并且符合真实物理效果。
它整张蓬松的小脸紧紧贴在玻璃上。小小的黑色鼻子被完全压扁，蓬松的脸颊向两侧挤开，嘴唇被压成滑稽的形状。胡须被玻璃压弯并朝两侧展开，小巧的耳朵因撞击向后压平。
其中一只眼睛被挤得稍微大一些，另一只眼睛则受到轻微压缩。碰撞使它粉红色的小舌头突然从嘴角弹出来，并且意外粘在玻璃上。
两只前爪同时“啪”地拍在玻璃表面，柔软的粉色与黑色小肉垫清晰可见。小狗的表情瞬间从充满自信的顽皮，变成彻底的困惑和茫然。
撞击发生的准确瞬间，写实的智能手机钢化玻璃上出现戏剧性的放射状蜘蛛网裂纹。裂纹以小狗被压扁的鼻子为中心，迅速蔓延至几乎整个屏幕。
玻璃依然保持完整，没有出现破洞，也没有任何玻璃碎片掉落。少量细微的玻璃粉尘短暂漂浮在空中，在温暖的光线下微微闪烁。
小狗保持着整张脸被压在玻璃上的状态大约一秒。它的舌头依然粘在玻璃上，鼻子留下一小块朦胧的雾气鼻印，舌头也留下一点湿润的痕迹。
它的一只眼睛慢慢变成斗鸡眼，并在完全困惑的状态下眨眼两次。嘴巴微微张开，露出十分滑稽的表情。即使脸仍然紧贴着玻璃，两侧蓬松的脸颊还在轻微抖动。
随后，重力开始慢慢将小狗向下拉。
它的脸依然紧贴着布满裂纹的玻璃，并沿着玻璃表面缓慢向下滑动。脸颊在玻璃上拖动，被压扁的鼻子稍微向下拉长。粘在玻璃上的舌头被滑稽地拉长，最后以轻微而富有弹性的动作从玻璃上剥离。
两只前爪也慢慢沿着玻璃向下滑，在玻璃表面留下几个细小的爪印。
小狗逐渐从画面底部消失。
紧接着，短短一瞬之后——
咚！
小狗安全地仰面摔落在摄像机下方。四只爪子全部朝上，蓬松的肚皮完全露出来，粉红色的小舌头依然伸在嘴巴外面。
它的双眼慢慢变成夸张、滑稽的卡通螺旋眼。一只小耳朵轻轻抽动一次，一条后腿不由自主地蹬了一下。蓬松卷曲的尾巴无力地轻轻甩动一次。胸口随着自然呼吸缓慢而轻柔地起伏。
安静躺了一会儿后，其中一只眼睛短暂恢复正常，仿佛它正在努力清醒过来。小狗随后慢慢摇了摇脑袋。
画面无缝渐变回故事开头。小狗再次安静地从毛毯下面探出蓬松的小脸，与第一个镜头完美衔接，形成自然流畅的无限循环。
超写实博美幼犬，毛发以纯白色为主，带有少量自然的暖金黄色毛发区域，整段视频中的毛色分布和外观始终保持一致，极其细腻的蓬松长毛，柔软浓密的双层被毛，自然真实的犬类行为，符合真实物理规律的身体动作，真实可信的面部撞击与玻璃挤压变形，写实的智能手机钢化玻璃裂纹，电影级灯光，温暖的室内氛围，4K HDR，竖屏9:16，浅景深，可爱、滑稽、温馨治愈，适合作为手机动态壁纸，首尾完美无缝循环。

Reference image: use the uploaded image as the character's identity and costume (pale porcelain skin, long platinum-blonde waved hair, jeweled silver tiara, drop earrings and choker, pale blue satin ball gown with silver bead embroidery and multicolored jewels, lace cuffs, pale blue beaded satin heel). Keep her identical in every cut. Refer to her only as the PRINCESS.

15-second cinematic fairy-tale sequence, 20 hard cuts (about 0.75 seconds each), 4:5 vertical, photorealistic, 24fps. A rose garden on a bright sunny day, deep blue cloudless sky, with a giant ornate golden carriage wheel beside her. The PRINCESS stands by the carriage with a cold, regal stare. She lifts her skirt, steps out onto the grass in her glass-like slipper, and walks toward the camera with quiet, imperious confidence. Strong midday sunlight, saturated colors, crisp shadows, light breeze moving her hair and skirt. Consistent location, lighting and wardrobe across all cuts. Fast, rhythmic editing with one smooth continuous action across the cuts.

Cuts:
1. (0.00-0.75s) Extreme low-angle wide shot, ultra-wide lens: the PRINCESS towers over the camera beside the golden carriage wheel, blue sky behind her.
2. (0.75-1.50s) Wide shot, eye level: the PRINCESS stands still among the rose bushes, breeze lifting her hair.
3. (1.50-2.25s) Medium shot, front: her chin lifts slightly, a cold, unimpressed expression.
4. (2.25-3.00s) Extreme close-up, front: her eyes, pale lashes, and the sparkle of her tiara above.
5. (3.00-3.75s) Close-up, side profile: the jeweled drop earring and choker catch the sun.
6. (3.75-4.50s) Extreme close-up, macro: her fingers gather the satin skirt, jewels and beadwork glittering.
7. (4.50-5.25s) Low angle, looking up: she raises the hem, the huge embroidered skirt filling the frame.
8. (5.25-6.00s) Ground-level shot in the grass: her beaded pale blue slipper lifts and steps forward, grass blades bending.
9. (6.00-6.75s) Detail shot, slightly low: the slipper presses into the grass, sunlight sparkling on the pearls.
10. (6.75-7.50s) Side tracking shot, medium: the PRINCESS walks away from the carriage, the golden wheel sliding past behind her.
11. (7.50-8.25s) Dutch angle, medium wide: she walks, the rose hedges and sky tilted behind her.
12. (8.25-9.00s) Rear tracking shot: her long waved hair and the embroidered back of the gown, following her through the garden.
13. (9.00-9.75s) High angle, top-down: the skirt sweeping across the green lawn, jeweled hem glittering.
14. (9.75-10.50s) Front tracking shot, backing away: she walks toward the camera with an imperious stare.
15. (10.50-11.25s) Close-up, three-quarter angle: her face in hard sunlight, the tiara glinting, expression unmoved.
16. (11.25-12.00s) Low angle, wide: the PRINCESS silhouetted against the deep blue sky, skirt billowing in the breeze.
17. (12.00-12.75s) Medium shot, side: she stops and slowly turns her head toward the camera.
18. (12.75-13.50s) Slow push-in, close-up front: a faint, cold, knowing smile.
19. (13.50-14.25s) Orbit shot, medium: the camera arcs around her, the golden wheel and roses sweeping past behind.
20. (14.25-15.00s) Final extreme low-angle wide shot, slow pull-back: the PRINCESS standing tall in the grass beside the golden carriage wheel, blue sky above, holding the pose.

Style: 35mm film photography look, saturated Kodak-style color, deep blue sky, crisp natural sunlight, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, realistic skin texture, realistic satin, lace, bead and jewel detail, realistic hair and cloth physics. Sound: soft breeze, distant birds, rustling grass and satin, light magical chimes building gently toward the end. No dialogue, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

prompts.prompt:
Hyperrealistic cinematic animal-rescue sequence. A blonde adult woman rides on the exterior of a dark stealth fighter jet skimming over a lake, rescues a small otter and lands safely on the nearby shore holding it.

Begin directly with the woman already on the aircraft. Remove the ruined-city introduction, dramatic landing, introductory face close-ups and approaching-aircraft setup.

Recreate the reference’s fantastical stunt as convincing live-action VFX, with natural human anatomy, photographic materials and a lifelike animal.

Reference:
Use the supplied video for the action sequence, character appearance, outfit, aircraft, otter, lake and affectionate ending.

Preserve the woman’s recognizable adult face, short side-parted blonde bob, blue eyes, fair skin and small gold hoop earrings.

Keep her sleeveless blue denim vest, black-and-cream horizontally striped long-sleeve shirt, fitted dark trousers, dark belt and brown mid-calf boots.

If a separate portrait is provided, use it for adult facial identity while preserving the reference outfit and staging.

Aircraft:
One consistent dark charcoal stealth fighter with an angular fuselage, pointed nose, smoked canopy, swept wings and twin tail fins.

Preserve its proportions, panel seams, materials and canopy placement throughout. The woman remains outside the closed cockpit.

Format:
Exactly 15 seconds, horizontal 16:9, 25 fps. Connected cinematic action shots with clear geography and movement direction.

No opening montage, text, subtitles, logo, watermark, interface or ending card.

Environment:
A broad freshwater lake beneath a clear blue sky, distant wooded shoreline and low hills. A low gravel-and-earth bank lies close to the rescue location.

Late-afternoon sunlight, natural water reflections and soft atmospheric haze. Damaged buildings may remain distant background details, without a separate establishing sequence.

Character and Animal Continuity:
One woman and one small otter throughout.

Maintain the woman’s face, hair length, clothing, boots and body proportions across every shot. Wind moves her hair and loose fabric consistently with the aircraft’s direction.

The otter has dark brown wet fur, a pale cream muzzle and throat, small rounded ears, glossy dark eyes, delicate whiskers, short paws and a tapered tail.

Keep it small enough to cradle securely against her chest. Its wet fur remains textured and clumped. Natural animal reactions, without human gestures or cartoon expressions.

Shot 1 — Already on the Jet | 0.0–2.0 seconds:
Open on a close side-tracking view of the woman lying low along the upper fuselage immediately behind the canopy, gripping a fixed edge with both hands.

The jet is already moving low over the lake. Her blonde bob streams backward, her striped sleeves flutter and her expression is focused.

Cut briefly wider to establish the aircraft, water below and nearby shore. A helmeted pilot may be glimpsed through the canopy without a separate cockpit scene.

Shot 2 — Rise and Notice the Otter | 2.0–3.5 seconds:
She pulls herself into a low crouch, then rises into a balanced stance with bent knees and arms slightly extended.

Preserve her hand placements and boot positions between cuts.

She looks down and ahead toward an otter stranded on a small floating tangle of sticks. Her expression changes from concentration to concern.

Shot 3 — Otter on the Raft | 3.5–5.0 seconds:
Water-level close-up of the wet otter gripping the loosely interwoven branches. Ripples rock the raft as it looks toward the approaching aircraft.

A short wide view establishes the jet passing immediately beside the raft, very low over the water, with the nearby shore ahead.

Spray, ripples and consistent screen direction connect the animal and aircraft.

Shot 4 — Onto the Aircraft | 5.0–7.0 seconds:
The otter makes one short desperate leap from the raft onto the forward upper fuselage.

Clearly show takeoff, airborne crossing and paw contact through connected shots.

It scrambles briefly on the sloping surface. The woman shifts toward it and reaches out. Droplets shed from its coat and its tail follows naturally.

Keep aircraft geometry and animal size consistent.

Shot 5 — Rescue Leap | 7.0–9.0 seconds:
As the aircraft passes close to shore, the otter slips and launches off the forward fuselage toward land.

The woman immediately pushes off with both boots and jumps after it.

Use a wide side view showing the aircraft, woman, otter, lake and shore together. Their trajectories follow readable arcs toward the nearby bank.

Apply a brief, restrained slow-motion emphasis as her hands approach the otter. Preserve body momentum, wind direction and fabric movement. Resume normal speed for the catch.

Shot 6 — Catch and Land | 9.0–12.0 seconds:
Medium tracking view as she catches the otter with both hands and draws it securely against her chest, supporting its body.

Show the moment of contact clearly.

Continue into a wider view of her landing on the low shore. Her boots contact gravel and soil, her knees bend and she takes one stabilizing step while protecting the animal.

Small pebbles shift and a restrained puff of dust responds to the landing.

The same aircraft continues across the lake in the background. The woman and otter remain uninjured.

Shot 7 — Safe Together | 12.0–15.0 seconds:
Settle into a warm close-up on shore.

She cradles the otter against her denim vest, exhales and smiles with relief. It looks up toward her.

She leans close and gently kisses its head or nose, matching the reference’s affectionate ending.

Show fine whiskers, wet fur, natural skin texture, earrings and loose blonde strands.

End with their faces together, the lake behind them and the aircraft receding into the distance. Preserve the final three seconds for this quiet emotional moment.

Camera:
Energetic side tracking, low water-level shots and clear wide views for the jumps. Realistic photographic perspective, controlled motion blur and movement-motivated cuts.

Keep hand-to-animal contact readable. Avoid camera spins that obscure the rescue.

Lighting and Materials:
Natural late-afternoon sunlight, cool lake reflections and warm skin highlights.

Detailed skin texture, woven striped fabric, worn denim, leather boots, wet animal fur, matte aircraft metal and realistic canopy reflections.

No waxy faces, plastic fur, exaggerated eyes or artificial glow.

Proposed Sound Design:
Jet-engine roar, rushing wind, disturbed water, brief otter chirps, clothing movement, a breath during the catch, boots landing on gravel and a relieved exhale.

Let engine noise recede as the aircraft departs. No required dialogue or narration.

Constraints:
One woman, one otter and one consistent aircraft.

Maintain identity, wardrobe, animal size, geography and movement direction. No duplicate animals, additional rescuers, extra limbs, fused hands, elongated animal body, floating boots, teleportation, aircraft morphing or instant catches.

No gore or injury. Preserve the fictional action while rendering it with photographic realism.

Finish with the otter safely held on shore at exactly 15 seconds.

prompts.prompt:
《GRAVITY COURT｜零重力街球》

【全局基准｜GLOBAL】制作一段25秒高能街球动作动画，厚涂美漫×NPR赛璐璐三渲二×Hip-Hop街头广告视觉。以黑、荧光橙、青蓝、米白为主色，粗犷手绘笔触、硬边大色块、哑光材质、网点阴影与少量漫画速度线，减少细碎描边和反光点。球场主光方向固定，远处霓虹只提供环境色。24fps摄影，人物姿态适量采用12fps错帧质感，运球、传球与身体接触保持连续。篮球始终是普通篮球，所有超现实动作来自局部重力变化、墙面反弹和空中身体控制。

【角色与空间】JAYE是年轻黑人女性街球手，短脏辫、橘色头带、黑色短款球衣、宽松篮球短裤，动作松弛，擅长节奏差和假动作。N-23是两米高的白灰色陪练机器人，细长四肢、蓝色光带面部，动作精准、认真，却不理解炫技。三台黑色安保机器人突然进入，试图清场。场景始终位于高楼之间的悬空街球场，四周透明防护墙，地板具有局部可变重力区域，篮筐固定在画面右侧。整段动作是一轮持续向篮筐推进的完整进攻。

【0—4秒｜全景转篮球与鞋底特写／贴地低机位／轻微倾斜／鱼眼推进＋落球卡点切镜】JAYE面对N-23松弛运球。篮球连续落地三次，镜头依次呈现右手运球、胯下换手、左手继续，切镜后承接同一次反弹，每次落地声都成为鼓点。第三次落球时，安保机器人的脚掌突然踏入画面，三台黑色机器人封住球场入口。

【4—8秒｜中近景转全身侧跟／胸高降至膝高／倾斜8°／短推近＋高速跟拍】JAYE瞥一眼来者，继续运球。第一台安保机伸臂拦截，她先突然降速，再用两个幅度极小的Crossover骗过重心，贴着机械臂下方穿出。球始终受她控制，肩、髋、脚步与换手动作共同完成假动作。N-23仍然认真保持训练姿态。

【8—14秒｜篮球跟随特写转纵向全景／随球低位仰拍／摄影旋转90°／Ball Cam＋纵向拉升＋甩镜】JAYE把球砸向左侧重力板，板面触发局部重力变化，篮球沿墙面向上弹升。她连续蹬墙追球，两台安保机紧跟。摄影旋转，让墙面短暂成为视觉上的地面。N-23按训练程序提前站稳做掩护，将追击路线分成两侧，再顺势向右侧篮筐前的两分区跟进。人物与球的位置连续可追踪。

【14—18秒｜漫画四格转腾空全景／贴地切极低仰拍／倾斜12°／Panel Cuts＋慢动作环绕】四格快速接力展示：篮球从墙面反弹、JAYE单手控制住球、鞋底踩入低重力区、三台安保机同时抬头。四格合并为完整画面，她借力跃起，在低重力中短暂滞空，收腿、转髋、篮球绕腰，城市夜景随环绕镜头掠过。动作由上一拍的蹬地推动，保留身体惯性与球的重量感。

【18—22秒｜空中全景转背部近景／与人物同高／轻微倾斜后回正／快速推近＋Whip Pan】三台安保机启动推进器，形成三角包夹。JAYE摆出即将完成高难度终结的姿态，在它们同时扑来的瞬间嘴角一扬，突然背后传球。篮球沿清楚的抛物线穿过包夹空隙，传给地面的N-23；甩镜沿球路跟到接球队友，三台安保机齐刷刷转头。

【22—25秒｜固定中景转反应近景／平视／水平构图／Static Shot＋最后一次Punch-In】所有激昂音乐骤停。N-23站稳接球，看一眼篮筐，用毫无情绪、教科书般标准的姿势轻轻投篮。篮球沿普通抛物线空心入网，只留下清晰的“唰”声，记分牌亮起“2”。N-23平静报出：“技术评分：标准。”切JAYE近景，她先愣一下，随即笑到蹲下，结束。

[REFERENCES]
Use @character as her locked visual identity - preserve her face, her very long warm chestnut brown hair worn loose in soft waves falling down her back behind her shoulders, body proportions and outfit exactly across the whole clip, keeping her face true to @character in every frame. Matte natural skin.
Use @penrose_motion only as the reference for the camera, the staircase's geometry and where she is: follow @penrose_motion exactly for the camera position, the camera's path and its timing, the true shape of the staircase, her path up the stairs, when she runs and when she stops, and her size in the frame at every moment. The gray pill-shaped marker in @penrose_motion only marks where Alessia is and how large she appears; it is not an object and not her body, it keeps the same height even when she crouches, and it never appears in the video. In its place she is a real young woman moving with real, natural human motion, every step a real step, never gliding.
Use @penrose_room as the exact look of the space: the square loop of solid board-formed concrete steps and landings floating in the air with plain open edges, the large dark opening in the floor beneath it dropping into deep darkness, the polished dark gray stone floor, the board-formed concrete side walls with small round tie holes, the three huge floor-to-ceiling glass panes in slim black frames on the back wall, and the overcast Tokyo skyline with Tokyo Tower outside. The framing of @penrose_room is the opening locked shot.

[STYLE + CAMERA]
16-second, 16:9 landscape, hyper-realistic live-action short, one continuous take, real-time the whole way, already running in the first frame. A young woman, Alessia, plays on a forced-perspective impossible staircase, a Penrose staircase, in a concrete atrium on a high floor of a Tokyo tower. The whole time she is curious and playful, exploring the strange staircase, her expressions light and natural. The camera is a smooth, steady cinema camera on a crane: until 6.5 seconds it stays fixed in exactly the same position high above the stairs, looking down at the whole loop, and only zooms in very slowly; at 6.5 seconds, the same instant her foot meets empty air, it cranes down and to the right in one smooth continuous move that stays inside the atrium, exactly as in @penrose_motion, then slowly pushes in toward her until the end.

LOCKED SET:
From the opening camera position the stairs read as one closed square loop where every flight climbs upward forever. In truth the staircase is a spiral: as it climbs, each flight comes a little closer to the camera, and the highest step, on the front-right flight nearest the camera, hangs high in mid-air, about five meters above the floor, directly over the dark opening, with nothing holding it up and nothing beyond its far edge. The next step of the loop, the lowest one, sits far below it, deeper than she is tall, and further back. This true shape only becomes visible once the camera moves, exactly as in @penrose_motion. The atrium is empty apart from her. Alessia is the only person in the space.

LIGHT:
The glass wall is the main light: soft overcast daylight coming in from the back of the atrium. The windows are bright and slightly overexposed, the atrium clearly dimmer than the city outside, like a real space lit by windows on a cloudy day. The floor and the walls are brightest near the windows and grow gradually darker toward the camera. The same daylight lights the city outside, the staircase and her, so she sits naturally in the space. Nobody specially lit, no fill light, face shadows stay natural. Muted, slightly desaturated cool gray tones, low contrast, the quiet natural light of a Christopher Nolan film.

OUTFIT (identical every frame):
A dusty-rose technical half-zip pullover blouse with a soft stand-up collar, the zip closed up to the base of the neck, a relaxed blousy body, full gathered sleeves with elastic cuffs, the hem tucked loosely into charcoal tailored cargo shorts with flap side pockets and turned-up hems. 21.0s to 25.0s — INSERT, 18°. The CCTV feed: the figure on screen raises its right hand one full second late. Then the figure lowers the hand, slowly turns its head over its shoulder, and looks straight up into the security camera lens.
25.0s HARD CUT
25.0s to 30.0s — ECU, 12°. His eyes and the bridge of his nose only, underlit by the screen. His body stays completely still. Only his eyes travel up and to camera-left, toward the ceiling corner behind the monitor where the dome camera hangs. At 29.0s the monitor turns off and his face drops into darkness, leaving only a faint teal catch-light in both eyes for one second. Cut to black at 30.0s.

ACTING TASK — @Image 1 (he is fully invested in his tactic; the work happens in his eyes):
SCENE DIRECTION (shared, unspoken): stay the professional, verify before reacting.
MOTIVE (his fuel): if this is real, the one who notices it calmly is the one who survives it.
GOAL: prove to himself it is a glitch, a loop, a recording, anything but live.
OBSTACLE: the timestamp keeps ticking in real time, and every check he runs makes it more true.
TACTIC: he tests the feed the way an analyst tests evidence. His eyes run between his own hand and the screen, comparing timing frame by frame, hunting for the lag that would expose a recording. When the figure looks up, his eyes do not panic. They calculate where the lens must be, then go find it.
Moment to moment:
— reading the grid — eyes sorting tile by tile, filing each as normal, until one refuses to be filed.
— raising the hand — eyes split between the hand's position and the screen, measuring the delay.
— the figure turns — eyes freeze for one beat, then begin the hunt for the real camera.
(Safety: gaze always engaged in the task, never a frozen, glassy, unfocused stare; natural blink cadence.)

PERFORMANCE
Restraint throughout, minimal facial movement. Pore-level skin realism and fine stubble texture. Faint sweat sheen at the temple appears only from 17s onward. Breath is held during the hand test and released through the nose after 25s. Living wet eyes catch the monitor light.

PHYSICS
The polo fabric creases naturally at the shoulder when he raises his arm. The mouse slides with real friction. Monitor light falls off on his skin with distance, brightest under the chin and nose. Dust particles drift slowly through the corridor spill light in the wide shot.

LIGHTING
Key: the monitor from below and in front, an underlight that lifts his chin, nostrils and cheekbones and leaves his forehead in falloff. Backlight: a cold corridor spill behind him draws a thin rim on his hair and shoulders. No fill, deep shadows. The face is exposed one stop under, and the screen-lit eyes sit as the brightest point on the face. White balance is 5600K with the monitor rendered cyan-teal.

COLOR GRADE
Cool, desaturated teal-blue. Near-black shadows lean deep green-teal like dark bottle glass. The monitor glow is a saturated petrol-teal hitting the skin, and the skin stays muted and slightly cool. The black polo sinks into the shadows with only a teal sheen on the fabric ridges. The CCTV inserts are cold monochrome grain with a faint green tint.

AUDIO
Low electrical hum of the office. A soft computer fan. Two clean mouse clicks at 7s. A sub-bass drone rises from 13s. Total silence from 21.0s to 24.5s, broken by a single sharp electronic tick as the figure looks up. A low hit when the screen goes black at 29s.

STYLE
Photoreal paranoid political-thriller look, grounded and procedural, 2.39:1 widescreen, fine organic digital grain, crisp center sharpness with soft edges.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
2.39:1, 24 fps real-time throughout. 8K detail intent.

POSITIVE LOCKS
@Image 1's face, hair and black polo stay identical in every shot and in the CCTV feed. Face shots stay centered with the dark monitor edge filling the lower 30% of frame. The monitor is the only key light in every interior close-up. The timestamps remain small, white and legible. The office stays dark and empty apart from him. Cuts only at the stated seconds.

Subject：林澈、钢梁

Subject：林澈、红色流星

26.0–28.0秒：日落时分，林澈在海岸线上空约150米处朝镜头方向步行，脚下没有任何东西。双腿交替迈步，双臂自然前后摆动，肩膀放松，头向左右转动看下方的海岸和城市，披风自然垂落并轻微摆动。

28.6–30.0秒：林澈上身向前倾倒变成水平，双臂收在身体两侧，朝镜头高速冲来，1秒内从全身变成脸部充满画面，从镜头左侧擦过飞出画面，最后画面只剩空的海岸线和红色流星。
Environment：画左是亮起灯光的海边城市，画右是金色反光的大海，远山呈淡紫色。

NEGATIVE / 全片负面约束：
慢动作、子弹时间、定格；换装；第二个主角；眼睛发光；手掌放出能量光；可读的文字、线路屏字样、车牌号、船名、Logo、水印、字幕；威亚绳、绿幕、支架；人物凭空出现或凭空消失；公交车翻车、快艇翻覆、多人落水、爆炸；吊装带缠绕在人身上；钢梁弯曲变形；出水后衣服和披风是干的；肢体穿插、多出手指；身体比例变形；塑料CG质感；镜头剧烈乱晃；角色脸部漂移；发型变化；服装变化；披风消失；战衣变成其他款式；靴子变化；角色突然变成其他女性。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic 16:9 1080p live-action video filmed like casual handheld footage by a friend using an older digital camera.

A young French woman in her early 20s, with long naturally loose dark-brown hair, wears a dark green knit sweater, black wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, and carries a small burgundy handbag. Keep her face, identity, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and handbag identical throughout.

LOCATION: A small independent movie theater in Lyon, France, around 8:30 PM. The theater is almost completely empty. Red fabric seats, dark carpet, narrow aisles, dim wall lights, small ticket counter, fictional movie posters, projector-room window, and a quiet lobby. Use only fictional movie titles and posters.

CAMERA: Raw handheld consumer-camera footage. Slight natural shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure adjustment, mild digital noise, natural motion blur and compression. No stabilization, cinematic bokeh, professional lighting, smooth tracking, or commercial/trailer aesthetic.

0-5s , EMPTY LOBBY  
Camera follows her through the nearly empty lobby. She looks around and quietly says, “We're really early.” She smiles and enters the screening room.

5-10s , FINDING A SEAT  
She walks down the aisle and chooses a middle seat. She sits naturally, compressing the fabric seat, and places her burgundy handbag beside her.

10-15s , PROJECTOR  
She looks toward the screen. A realistic projector beam cuts through the darkness, with dust visible only inside the beam. She looks at the camera and whispers, “Look at that.” Camera tilts slightly toward the projector.

15-20s , POPCORN  
She notices a half-empty popcorn bucket on a nearby empty seat. She picks it up, looks confused, and says, “Someone forgot this.” She places it on the floor beside the seat.

20-25s , LIGHTS DIM  
The theater lights suddenly become darker. The projector becomes brighter and softly illuminates her face. She looks around briefly, then settles into her seat.

25-30s , QUIET MOMENT  
Camera stays behind her shoulder as she watches the screen. Only soft fictional screen light illuminates her face. She briefly turns and smiles at the camera. Autofocus becomes slightly soft as the camera moves, then the video ends naturally.

AUDIO: Natural theater ambience only,quiet footsteps, carpet movement, seat sounds, fabric movement, distant lobby sounds, projector fan, electrical hum, room echo, and quiet whispers. NO background music. Movie audio must be indistinct and completely original.

REALISM: Physically accurate projector light, dust, shadows, seat compression, handbag deformation, hair and clothing movement, and screen illumination. No recognizable movie footage or dialogue.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: CGI, animation, 3D render, plastic skin, beauty filter, face morphing, identity drift, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicated people, floating objects, impossible lighting, fake projector beam, excessive HDR, oversaturation, artificial bokeh, cinematic trailer look, perfect stabilization, exaggerated acting, horror effects, wardrobe changes, hairstyle changes, continuity errors, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, real movie posters, copyrighted footage, copyrighted dialogue, copyrighted music.

FINAL STYLE: Quiet, ordinary, slightly nostalgic, intimate, imperfect, and genuinely believable,like a friend casually recording an almost-empty cinema before a movie starts.

prompts.prompt:
30 seconds, 16:9, cinematic animation with realistic adult human proportions and real materials, normal-speed motion, natural motion blur. One continuous nighttime campfire dinner scene told in 8 cuts. Three adult women talk about life after leaving the dead city. A small detection drone performs routine patrol and shoots down one harassing crow. The guard incident must not interrupt the conversation rhythm: at most a casual glance, no panic, no standing in alarm, no sword-grabbing, no stopping the fish roast. Outside the fence is harsh and dangerous; by the fire, they can still read each other’s eyes and smiles. All intelligible dialogue must use only the English lines listed below. No subtitles, narration, opening or ending cards.

[Reference Responsibilities]
Image 1 = Alin, wounded platinum-haired adult woman. Lock face shape, light eyes, blunt bangs, torn white top, blue jeans, boots, and scar positions. Add one weathered gray-brown blanket over her legs without changing the clothing. She remains weak from severe injury and stays seated and supported throughout.
Image 2 = Lisa, short blonde adult woman. Lock face shape, blue eyes, orange-brown leather jacket with pale fur collar, inner layers, dark skirt, waist bag, and ankle boots. Never rename her Elin.
Image 3 = Hia, dark-haired adult woman with a bun. Lock East Asian face, hair ornament, dark blue-black and deep red embroidered long coat, belt, and boots. Her sheathed long sword stays on the outer side of her bench for the whole scene; never rename her Jia.
Image 4 = the only environment reference. Keep the spatial relationship among shipping container, canopy, corrugated fence, gate, fire pit, benches, water jar, and worktable; convert daytime to deep night. Use the main wide view to set layout; the fire-pit detail view only informs materials and structure. Render as one complete location. Do not include reference layouts, labels, numbers, split panels, or character turnarounds.
Image 5 = the only detection drone: orange-yellow spherical shell, central observation eye, two side-deploying firing units. Keep the reference structure. It shoots short pulse lasers; the center eye observes, the laser emits from the side barrels.
Image 6 = bloodthirsty crow reference for feathers, beak, claws, and dark red eyes. Keep normal real crow size and avian skeletal structure. Eyes only catch dim reflections and do not glow outward.

Only three humans appear: Alin, Lisa, Hia, plus one drone. Character identity, costume, prop design, and material finish come only from their own references and cannot be swapped.

[Real Scale]
All three women follow normal adult female scale, roughly 1.65–1.75 m standing height. Perspective may change screen size but not world scale.
Crows are normal-sized: about 40–45 cm beak to tail, 80–90 cm wingspan, never giant ravens or raptors.
The drone is small: folded sphere about 12 cm diameter, about 20 cm wide when firing units are deployed, small enough to hold in one hand, smaller than an adult head and clearly smaller than a same-depth crow torso. It hovers about 2.2–2.6 m above ground. Never stage it as a large UAV or manned craft. Keep fence posts, canopy edges, or crows in frame as scale references, and avoid ultra-close wide-angle enlargement.
There are only three fish, each about 25 cm long, skewered on thin branches about 60 cm long, with visible tail fins and blistered skin.
The stone-ring fire pit is about 1.2 m wide. The burning zone stays modest: mostly glowing coals with flames about 20–35 cm high. Fish roast over the coal edge nearest the characters, not in the center of the flames.

[Locked Space and Blocking]
Use the main viewing direction from the gate side toward the rear container as the scene axis, called south-to-north for this scene only. Fire pit center is the origin. Screen right is east; the container side is north.

A = Alin = Image 1. Fixed north of the fire, slightly west, around (-0.35, 1.65)m. She leans against a wooden crate with an old cushion, body turned south-southeast so she can see the other two. Her head and shoulders must always remain visible between them and never be fully blocked by furniture or bodies.
B = Lisa = Image 2. Starts seated on the north end of the northwest bench, around (-0.95, 0.45)m, body facing southeast, able to turn toward Hia. She is about 1.3 m from Alin, feet planted on clear ground outside the fire ring.
C = Hia = Image 3. Fixed on the northeast bench, around (0.95, 0.45)m, body facing southwest toward Lisa. Both feet stay grounded. She never changes seats or stands.

Before 18 seconds, all three stay fixed at their ground positions. From 18–21 seconds, Lisa takes the largest fish, rises from the north end of her bench, walks two small steps along the west side of the fire to crouch beside Alin at about (-0.90, 1.55)m, with shoulders roughly 0.55 m apart. She always avoids the stone ring and Hia, never crosses the fire, never passes through furniture, never teleports. After 21 seconds she stays there until the end.

All camera angles remain in the southern fan of this triangle. Lisa always stays on world west, Hia on world east, Alin on world north. Close-ups may reframe but must not swap positions. Camera can move; the floor anchors do not. Lisa is the only character with one clear relocation.

At the start, all three fish are set into the north half of the fire’s coal edge. The largest one is in front of Lisa’s right hand; Lisa tends it, then later removes it with her right hand and offers it to Alin. One fish remains in its original place. The third is in front of Hia. From 27–30 seconds Hia removes the one in front of her. Final fish state: Alin and Lisa jointly support the largest fish, Hia holds one fish, and one fish remains by the fire. Total remains three.

The drone follows a slow closed patrol route above the fence, autonomously adjusting orientation. It continues patrolling off-screen as well and stabilizes only briefly at the kill moment. Around 12 seconds it reaches the east inner fence line and fires outward, away from people and food. Three crows begin in fixed zones: one on the east canopy edge, one on the west fence top, one outside the south gate wall. Only the east crow is shot down. The other two remain in their original zones with only minor head turns, wing tucks, or foot shifts, never becoming a sudden flock.

[Unified Tone and Five-Color Palette]
Overall look: low-saturation cold gray-blue post-apocalyptic night, with localized amber campfire warmth. Preserve natural skin tone, rough metal, leather, and dust texture. HEX values are art references only, never on screen.
Midnight blue-black #151E28: sky and deepest ruins beyond the fence, dark but still readable.
Cool steel gray-blue #526373: moonlit metal, canopy roof, and background shadow.
Weathered wood gray-brown #766457: benches, dirt, blanket, and unlit daily objects.
Ember amber #D9954E: near-fire highlights, fish skin reflections, warm cloth edges, restricted to the fire zone.
Natural warm skin #C89E87: skin under firelight, with each woman retaining her own reference complexion; Alin slightly pale but never blue.

Campfire gives a local 2000–2400K warmth. Night ambience feels like weak 6500–7500K skylight. Camera white balance stays fixed around 4300K across all shots. Background is about two stops darker than faces, but shadow sides of faces still hold eyes, scars, and costume layers. Protect Alin’s white shirt and platinum hair from turning orange. Keep Lisa’s jacket orange-brown, not fluorescent orange. Hia’s dark coat must still show folds and embroidery.
The fire is the only warm world light source. The side facing the fire reads warmer; the opposite side keeps a slight cold edge. When camera angle changes, light direction changes according to space only; never invent frontal beauty light. Highlights roll off softly, fire reflections in eyes stay small and flicker subtly, and skin retains texture. Keep one consistent black level, shadow hue, and fine grain. No heavy teal-orange grade, no full-frame yellow haze, no fake day-for-night.

[Performance and Fixed Voices]
Lisa wants Hia to catch her joke about opening a shop, then bring Alin into it. She talks while minding the fish, eyes lifting before the head. When Hia reminds her, she turns the fish and briefly presses her lips; she never plays cute to camera. When Alin joins in, Lisa looks to her first and then lets the smile open. When handing over the fish, she slows down and protects Alin’s weak grip. Natural blinking, small gaze shifts, firelight in the eyes. Body rhythm alternates between light and careful, never constant bouncing, never broad laughter.
Lisa Voice: "An adult woman with a light, clear mid-range voice and a neutral conversational English accent. Brisk but unhurried phrasing, playful emphasis, a soft smile in the voice; gentler volume when addressing Alin."

Hia lets Lisa keep fantasizing while still tending food. Neck and shoulders loose but stable, hand movements economical, gaze moving with purpose among fish, Lisa, and Alin. Slow natural blinks. On her first line, she looks at the fish before lifting her eyes and teases in a short sentence. The patrol shot only earns one casual checking glance; breath and hand rhythm never break. At the end she looks at Lisa, lifts the corner of her mouth slightly, and accepts the promise without playing sadness or farewell.
Hia Voice: "An adult woman with a low, clear, lightly textured voice and a neutral conversational English accent. Economical phrasing, steady breath, dry understated humor; soft volume and clean consonants."

Alin wants to join the joke but still needs physical support. Her back and shoulders stay against the cushion, breathing shallow but continuous, arm movements small. When Lisa talks about the shop, Alin’s eyes follow Lisa first, then she answers with a little smile. She takes a light inhale before speaking; voice is soft but clear, no coughing, no sudden upright recovery, no return to strength. When receiving the fish, she only lifts the nearer left hand and Lisa helps support it. Her smile lives in the eyes and mouth corners, never a big laugh.
Alin Voice: "An adult woman with a soft, slightly breathy mid-low voice and a neutral conversational English accent. Quiet, gently spaced words on limited breath, with understated dry humor; never whispery to the point of losing clarity."

In close shots, keep moist eyes, small gaze shifts, and natural blinking. Listeners may begin to lift their eyes or smile before the speaker fully finishes, but must not interrupt. Only the current speaker performs English mouth shapes; others only breathe or smile. The five dialogue lines are each spoken once only, with stable voice character across cuts and no added shouting, exposition, or improvised lines.

[Wind, Fire, Dust, and Guard Effects]
A light breeze stays fixed from west to east, left-to-right in the main view. Character performance remains the primary foreground action; environmental effects stay low-intensity and never all compete as visual centers.

Fire: thin wood and red coals burn steadily. Flames rise first, then drift slightly east. A few sparks rise on heat, float a few dozen centimeters, then dim out; no full-screen particles. Thin smoke rises from the fuel and drifts east, away from faces and mouths. Small oil drops from fish skin may hit coals with a soft sizzle but never repeated flare-ups. Heat distortion exists only in a small area above the fire; faces stay stable and readable.

Breeze: Lisa’s short hair tips move lightly; the fur collar only trembles slightly. Hia’s bun stays intact; fine hairs and ribbon ends occasionally drift east; coat hem lifts a little and settles. Alin’s hair edges move gently; the blanket corner trembles while the part resting on her legs stays weighted. Heavy leather only folds with body movement and never flutters like silk. Loose canopy edges tremble lightly, corrugated metal may click softly, and dust stays sparse and low enough that facial features remain readable.

Shooting: the drone stabilizes, makes one short aiming adjustment, shows a tiny glow at the side barrel, then fires one narrow short warm-white laser directly to the target. No projectile, no sustained barrage, no thick beam, no full-screen flash. The beam is only faintly visible in thin dust and does not alter exposure. The impact on the crow creates only a small hot point and two or three loose feathers, with no fireball or blood mist.

Crow action: after pushing off from the canopy edge, the wings beat with realistic avian mechanics and flexible primary feathers. After impact it loses lift and drops along its existing outward trajectory. Wings and tail change position during the fall; the body never freezes stiff in air. It lands on dry sand outside the east wall, creating one small low dust puff that drifts east and settles. The fall stays far from the dinner; no feathers or body parts fly near the food. The drone then retracts its firing posture and resumes patrol. The other crows’ head turns and foot shifts do not sync with the humans.

[English Dialogue and Timing]
04.0–08.4, Lisa to Hia: "When we get out, I'm opening a fish place."
09.4–10.5, Hia to Lisa: "Flip it first."
13.1–15.8, Alin to Lisa: "Can I run a tab?"
20.5–23.5, Lisa, looking first at Alin then carrying the look to Hia: "You two? Free food for life."
24.7–26.9, Hia to Lisa: "I'm holding you to that."

Lisa lands lightly on "fish place" as an offhand dream, not a speech. Hia lets "first" close gently. Alin gives "tab" a slight questioning lift on limited breath. Lisa leaves a very short pause after "You two?" and lets "for life" land naturally, not like a last testament. Hia’s final line keeps the same volume and finishes with a faint smile.

[30-Second Shot Timeline]
Shot 01 | 00.0–03.0 | locked high oblique wide shot, 35mm.
Camera at the south canopy side around 2.8 m high, looking down about 25 degrees, showing the full fire-to-three-person geometry. A canopy-edge crow occupies only a small edge area. The three women form a depth triangle around the fire. The drone passes above the east fence as a small object, never enlarged near lens. End with Lisa beginning to turn the large fish. Sound opens with continuous wind, one distant crow call, and close fire crackle, never a scare cue.

Shot 02 | 03.0–09.0 | low medium close-up on Lisa, 50mm, slow lateral move.
From the south side slightly west of the fire, near seated chest height, looking up less than 10 degrees. A branch and fish occupy only one corner of foreground.
